Why Live in Merida?
-------------------

Enjoy luxury living in one of the most beautiful colonial cities in Mexico. Known as the “cultural capital” of the Mexico Yucatan Peninsula, Merida is a vibrant, welcoming city 

Merida is known as _ciudad blanca_ (white city) because of the heavy use of white limestone as a building material, although as you roam the grid-like streets you can expect to find homes and shops decorated in delightful pastel colors.

Stroll down colorful streets, sip coffee in charming cafes, and spend your free time exploring the magnificent monuments and historic buildings. You’ll never run out of things to do in Merida! 

The Top 10 Best Things to Do in Merida
--------------------------------------

### 1\. Discover Local Yucatan Cuisine

Merida is home to some of the best food in Mexico, and while favorites like tacos and _elote_ (corn) Merida boasts some delicious regional dishes that are a must-try for any foodie.

With roots in Mayan cooking but heavily influenced by Europe, the Caribbean, and other regions throughout Mexico, Yucatan cuisine is unique, delicious, and distinctive from anywhere else in Mexico.

Some of our favorite dishes are:

*   **Huevos Motuleños:** a Yucatan specialty breakfast dish of fried eggs over black beans on a fried tortilla, served with salsa, plantains, chorizo, and queso fresco.
*   **Queso relleno:** a hollowed-out ball of Edam cheese filled with ground pork and smothered in gravy.
*   **Poc-chuc:** a traditional Mayan dish marinated of thinly-sliced pork marinated in sour orange juice and served with pickled onions.
*   **Cochinita pibil (Yucatán-style barbecued pork):** this dish of pulled pork shoulder marinated and braised in achiote paste, orange juice, and lime is perfect for tacos.

### 2\. Stroll the Boutiques at Casa Tho

Casa Tho Concept House is named after the Mayan name for Merida, T’hō, and is the perfect place to stroll around on a lazy afternoon.

This stunning renovated mansion offers a handful of boutique shops selling jewelry, clothing, perfumes, and more.

### 3\. Get Lost in the Lucas de Galvez Market Merida

Merida’s main market, the Lucas de Galvez market is a bustling market that dates back to the late 1800s when it was just a small shed.

Nowadays, the market is a sprawling, chaotic, and a great place to pick up fruits, vegetables, handmade local crafts, and lots more. 

### 4\. Celebrate at One of Merida’s Annual Festivals

Merida boasts a variety of annual festivals and events, including:

*   Merida Fest (January)
*   Carnival of Merida (February)
*   Semana Santa Processions (April)
*   La Noche Blanca (May)
*   Mexican Independence Day (September)
*   Day of the Dead (November)
*   Christmas (December)

These are just a handful of events and festivals you can enjoy living in Merida!

### 5\. Grab a Bite at Merida’s Restaurant Row

Located at the southern end of Paseo Montejo to Calle 47 (47th Street) you can find “restaurant row”, a stretch of places to eat and drink that will satisfy any appetite.

Some of our favorite restaurants include:

*   [Cafe Latte Quattro Sette](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d12103961-Reviews-Latte_Quattro_Sette-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-MYF7YpUpFBMQ6ZsIpNYqV)
    : A gorgeous coffee shop with decadent pastries.
*   [Catrin](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d13483140-Reviews-El_Catrin-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-OMpZ6rAQPopqNb2mPm3oA)
    : A hip gastropub with funky artwork on the walls
*   [Oliva Enoteca](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d7720030-Reviews-Oliva_Enoteca-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-ZmZxeFM7el7UPIPFemPAb)
    : An upscale Italian restaurant with a great wine list
*   [Amado by The Beer Box](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150811-d23193817-Reviews-Amado_By_The_Beer_Box-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html)
    : A beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant with live jazz several nights a week

### 6\. Go Organic at the Slow Food Market

Looking for a  more upscale farmer’s market experience? Then spend a Saturday strolling through the Slow Food Market.

It’s the perfect place to pick up organic meat, produce, as well as oils, fresh-baked goods, and other artisanal products.

### 7\. Join the BiciRuta

On Sunday mornings, both residents and tourists alike come out for a city-wide bike ride from 8 AM – 12 PM!

BiciRuta means “bike route’ is one of the most popular things to do in Merida, offering free bike and paid bike rentals as well as a chance to people-watch as you cruise around the city.

### 8\. Catch a Game of Pok Ta Pok

Pok Ta Pok is an ancient sport that is re-enacted every week in front of the Cathedral. Every Wednesday, head down to watch players fight it out to the sounds of traditional music.

The players slide along the cobblestones while attempting to score by hitting the ball into the post using just their hips. 

There’s no Pok Ta Pok league (the game is re-created for entertainment purposes) but that doesn’t mean that it isn’t a fun and exciting spectacle that you can catch every week while living in Merida.

### 9\. Grab a Drink (or Two, or Three)

Happy hour runs late in Merida, and there’s no shortage of places to grab cervezas, margaritas, micheladas, or palomas. You can even try pox (pronounced poche) which is a regional specialty drink made from corn.

If traditional cantinas aren’t your thing, there’s a growing craft beer scene with new options popping up in the centro all the time.

### 10\. Dance in the Streets During a Weekly Fiesta

There’s something to do every night in Merida! At night the city’s streets and plazas light up and come to life with dances, performances, concerts, and more. 

On weekends, several of the main streets are closed to traffic and street performers spill out into the streets. 

Featuring regional music and dance, these events are open to the public and are often lined with food trucks and pop-up stalls in case you feel hungry after dancing the night away.

### Living in Merida Mexico

Now that you’ve learned about all there is to see and do in Merida, it’s time to find your dream property! [Contact us today](https://www.meridarealestategroup.com/contact-us/)
 to enjoy luxury, upscale living in Merida, Mexico.

Why Live in Merida?
-------------------

Enjoy luxury living in one of the most beautiful colonial cities in Mexico. Known as the “cultural capital” of the Mexico Yucatan Peninsula, Merida is a vibrant, welcoming city 

Merida is known as _ciudad blanca_ (white city) because of the heavy use of white limestone as a building material, although as you roam the grid-like streets you can expect to find homes and shops decorated in delightful pastel colors.

Stroll down colorful streets, sip coffee in charming cafes, and spend your free time exploring the magnificent monuments and historic buildings. You’ll never run out of things to do in Merida! 

The Top 10 Best Things to Do in Merida
--------------------------------------

### 1\. Discover Local Yucatan Cuisine

Merida is home to some of the best food in Mexico, and while favorites like tacos and _elote_ (corn) Merida boasts some delicious regional dishes that are a must-try for any foodie.

With roots in Mayan cooking but heavily influenced by Europe, the Caribbean, and other regions throughout Mexico, Yucatan cuisine is unique, delicious, and distinctive from anywhere else in Mexico.

Some of our favorite dishes are:

*   **Huevos Motuleños:** a Yucatan specialty breakfast dish of fried eggs over black beans on a fried tortilla, served with salsa, plantains, chorizo, and queso fresco.
*   **Queso relleno:** a hollowed-out ball of Edam cheese filled with ground pork and smothered in gravy.
*   **Poc-chuc:** a traditional Mayan dish marinated of thinly-sliced pork marinated in sour orange juice and served with pickled onions.
*   **Cochinita pibil (Yucatán-style barbecued pork):** this dish of pulled pork shoulder marinated and braised in achiote paste, orange juice, and lime is perfect for tacos.

### 2\. Stroll the Boutiques at Casa Tho

Casa Tho Concept House is named after the Mayan name for Merida, T’hō, and is the perfect place to stroll around on a lazy afternoon.

This stunning renovated mansion offers a handful of boutique shops selling jewelry, clothing, perfumes, and more.

### 3\. Get Lost in the Lucas de Galvez Market Merida

Merida’s main market, the Lucas de Galvez market is a bustling market that dates back to the late 1800s when it was just a small shed.

Nowadays, the market is a sprawling, chaotic, and a great place to pick up fruits, vegetables, handmade local crafts, and lots more. 

### 4\. Celebrate at One of Merida’s Annual Festivals

Merida boasts a variety of annual festivals and events, including:

*   Merida Fest (January)
*   Carnival of Merida (February)
*   Semana Santa Processions (April)
*   La Noche Blanca (May)
*   Mexican Independence Day (September)
*   Day of the Dead (November)
*   Christmas (December)

These are just a handful of events and festivals you can enjoy living in Merida!

### 5\. Grab a Bite at Merida’s Restaurant Row

Located at the southern end of Paseo Montejo to Calle 47 (47th Street) you can find “restaurant row”, a stretch of places to eat and drink that will satisfy any appetite.

Some of our favorite restaurants include:

*   [Cafe Latte Quattro Sette](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d12103961-Reviews-Latte_Quattro_Sette-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-MYF7YpUpFBMQ6ZsIpNYqV)
    : A gorgeous coffee shop with decadent pastries.
*   [Catrin](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d13483140-Reviews-El_Catrin-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-OMpZ6rAQPopqNb2mPm3oA)
    : A hip gastropub with funky artwork on the walls
*   [Oliva Enoteca](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d7720030-Reviews-Oliva_Enoteca-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-ZmZxeFM7el7UPIPFemPAb)
    : An upscale Italian restaurant with a great wine list
*   [Amado by The Beer Box](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150811-d23193817-Reviews-Amado_By_The_Beer_Box-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html)
    : A beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant with live jazz several nights a week

### 6\. Go Organic at the Slow Food Market

Looking for a  more upscale farmer’s market experience? Then spend a Saturday strolling through the Slow Food Market.

It’s the perfect place to pick up organic meat, produce, as well as oils, fresh-baked goods, and other artisanal products.

### 7\. Join the BiciRuta

On Sunday mornings, both residents and tourists alike come out for a city-wide bike ride from 8 AM – 12 PM!

BiciRuta means “bike route’ is one of the most popular things to do in Merida, offering free bike and paid bike rentals as well as a chance to people-watch as you cruise around the city.

### 8\. Catch a Game of Pok Ta Pok

Pok Ta Pok is an ancient sport that is re-enacted every week in front of the Cathedral. Every Wednesday, head down to watch players fight it out to the sounds of traditional music.

The players slide along the cobblestones while attempting to score by hitting the ball into the post using just their hips. 

There’s no Pok Ta Pok league (the game is re-created for entertainment purposes) but that doesn’t mean that it isn’t a fun and exciting spectacle that you can catch every week while living in Merida.

### 9\. Grab a Drink (or Two, or Three)

Happy hour runs late in Merida, and there’s no shortage of places to grab cervezas, margaritas, micheladas, or palomas. You can even try pox (pronounced poche) which is a regional specialty drink made from corn.

If traditional cantinas aren’t your thing, there’s a growing craft beer scene with new options popping up in the centro all the time.

### 10\. Dance in the Streets During a Weekly Fiesta

There’s something to do every night in Merida! At night the city’s streets and plazas light up and come to life with dances, performances, concerts, and more. 

On weekends, several of the main streets are closed to traffic and street performers spill out into the streets. 

Featuring regional music and dance, these events are open to the public and are often lined with food trucks and pop-up stalls in case you feel hungry after dancing the night away.

Why Live in Merida?
-------------------

Enjoy luxury living in one of the most beautiful colonial cities in Mexico. Known as the “cultural capital” of the Mexico Yucatan Peninsula, Merida is a vibrant, welcoming city 

Merida is known as _ciudad blanca_ (white city) because of the heavy use of white limestone as a building material, although as you roam the grid-like streets you can expect to find homes and shops decorated in delightful pastel colors.

Stroll down colorful streets, sip coffee in charming cafes, and spend your free time exploring the magnificent monuments and historic buildings. You’ll never run out of things to do in Merida! 

The Top 10 Best Things to Do in Merida
--------------------------------------

### 1\. Discover Local Yucatan Cuisine

Merida is home to some of the best food in Mexico, and while favorites like tacos and _elote_ (corn) Merida boasts some delicious regional dishes that are a must-try for any foodie.

With roots in Mayan cooking but heavily influenced by Europe, the Caribbean, and other regions throughout Mexico, Yucatan cuisine is unique, delicious, and distinctive from anywhere else in Mexico.

Some of our favorite dishes are:

*   **Huevos Motuleños:** a Yucatan specialty breakfast dish of fried eggs over black beans on a fried tortilla, served with salsa, plantains, chorizo, and queso fresco.
*   **Queso relleno:** a hollowed-out ball of Edam cheese filled with ground pork and smothered in gravy.
*   **Poc-chuc:** a traditional Mayan dish marinated of thinly-sliced pork marinated in sour orange juice and served with pickled onions.
*   **Cochinita pibil (Yucatán-style barbecued pork):** this dish of pulled pork shoulder marinated and braised in achiote paste, orange juice, and lime is perfect for tacos.

### 2\. Stroll the Boutiques at Casa Tho

Casa Tho Concept House is named after the Mayan name for Merida, T’hō, and is the perfect place to stroll around on a lazy afternoon.

This stunning renovated mansion offers a handful of boutique shops selling jewelry, clothing, perfumes, and more.

### 3\. Get Lost in the Lucas de Galvez Market Merida

Merida’s main market, the Lucas de Galvez market is a bustling market that dates back to the late 1800s when it was just a small shed.

Nowadays, the market is a sprawling, chaotic, and a great place to pick up fruits, vegetables, handmade local crafts, and lots more. 

### 4\. Celebrate at One of Merida’s Annual Festivals

Merida boasts a variety of annual festivals and events, including:

*   Merida Fest (January)
*   Carnival of Merida (February)
*   Semana Santa Processions (April)
*   La Noche Blanca (May)
*   Mexican Independence Day (September)
*   Day of the Dead (November)
*   Christmas (December)

These are just a handful of events and festivals you can enjoy living in Merida!

### 5\. Grab a Bite at Merida’s Restaurant Row

Located at the southern end of Paseo Montejo to Calle 47 (47th Street) you can find “restaurant row”, a stretch of places to eat and drink that will satisfy any appetite.

Some of our favorite restaurants include:

*   [Cafe Latte Quattro Sette](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d12103961-Reviews-Latte_Quattro_Sette-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-MYF7YpUpFBMQ6ZsIpNYqV)
    : A gorgeous coffee shop with decadent pastries.
*   [Catrin](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d13483140-Reviews-El_Catrin-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-OMpZ6rAQPopqNb2mPm3oA)
    : A hip gastropub with funky artwork on the walls
*   [Oliva Enoteca](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d7720030-Reviews-Oliva_Enoteca-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-ZmZxeFM7el7UPIPFemPAb)
    : An upscale Italian restaurant with a great wine list
*   [Amado by The Beer Box](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150811-d23193817-Reviews-Amado_By_The_Beer_Box-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html)
    : A beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant with live jazz several nights a week

### 6\. Go Organic at the Slow Food Market

Looking for a  more upscale farmer’s market experience? Then spend a Saturday strolling through the Slow Food Market.

It’s the perfect place to pick up organic meat, produce, as well as oils, fresh-baked goods, and other artisanal products.

### 7\. Join the BiciRuta

On Sunday mornings, both residents and tourists alike come out for a city-wide bike ride from 8 AM – 12 PM!

BiciRuta means “bike route’ is one of the most popular things to do in Merida, offering free bike and paid bike rentals as well as a chance to people-watch as you cruise around the city.

### 8\. Catch a Game of Pok Ta Pok

Pok Ta Pok is an ancient sport that is re-enacted every week in front of the Cathedral. Every Wednesday, head down to watch players fight it out to the sounds of traditional music.

The players slide along the cobblestones while attempting to score by hitting the ball into the post using just their hips. 

There’s no Pok Ta Pok league (the game is re-created for entertainment purposes) but that doesn’t mean that it isn’t a fun and exciting spectacle that you can catch every week while living in Merida.

### 9\. Grab a Drink (or Two, or Three)

Happy hour runs late in Merida, and there’s no shortage of places to grab cervezas, margaritas, micheladas, or palomas. You can even try pox (pronounced poche) which is a regional specialty drink made from corn.

If traditional cantinas aren’t your thing, there’s a growing craft beer scene with new options popping up in the centro all the time.

### 10\. Dance in the Streets During a Weekly Fiesta

There’s something to do every night in Merida! At night the city’s streets and plazas light up and come to life with dances, performances, concerts, and more. 

On weekends, several of the main streets are closed to traffic and street performers spill out into the streets. 

Featuring regional music and dance, these events are open to the public and are often lined with food trucks and pop-up stalls in case you feel hungry after dancing the night away.

Privacy Policy
==============

Welcome to https://www.meridarealestategroup.com (the “Site”). We understand that privacy online is important to users of our Site, especially when conducting business. This statement governs our privacy policies with respect to those users of the Site (“Visitors”) who visit without transacting business and Visitors who register to transact business on the Site and make use of the various services offered by  
Merida Real Estate Group (collectively, “Services”) (“Authorized Customers”).

### “Personally Identifiable Information”

refers to any information that identifies or can be used to identify, contact, or locate the person to whom such information pertains, including, but not limited to, name, address, phone number, fax number, email address, financial profiles, social security number, and credit card information. Personally Identifiable Information does not include information that is collected anonymously (that is, without identification of the individual user) or demographic information not connected to an identified individual.

### What Personally Identifiable Information is collected?

We may collect basic user profile information from all of our Visitors. We collect the following additional information from our Authorized Customers: the name, email address, phone number,

### What organizations are collecting the information?

In addition to our direct collection of information, our third party service vendors (such as credit card companies, clearinghouses and banks) who may provide such services as credit, insurance, and escrow services may collect this information from our Visitors and Authorized Customers. We do not control how these third parties use such information, but we do ask them to disclose how they use personal information provided to them from Visitors and Authorized Customers. Some of these third parties may be intermediaries that act solely as links in the distribution chain, and do not store, retain, or use the information given to them.

### How does the Site use Personally Identifiable Information?

We use Personally Identifiable Information to customize the Site, to make appropriate service offerings, and to fulfill buying and selling requests on the Site. We may email Visitors and Authorized Customers about research or purchase and selling opportunities on the Site or information related to the subject matter of the Site. We may also use Personally Identifiable Information to contact Visitors and Authorized Customers in response to specific inquiries, or to provide requested information.

### With whom may the information may be shared?

Personally Identifiable Information about Authorized Customers may be shared with other Authorized Customers who wish to evaluate potential transactions with other Authorized Customers. We may share aggregated information about our Visitors, including the demographics of our Visitors and Authorized Customers, with our affiliated agencies and third party vendors. We also offer the opportunity to “opt out” of receiving information or being contacted by us or by any agency acting on our behalf.

### How is Personally Identifiable Information stored?

Personally Identifiable Information collected by Merida Real Estate Group is securely stored and is not accessible to third parties or employees of Merida Real Estate Group except for use as indicated above.

### What choices are available to Visitors regarding collection, use and distribution of the information?

Visitors and Authorized Customers may opt out of receiving unsolicited information from or being contacted by us and/or our vendors and affiliated agencies by responding to emails as instructed, or by contacting us at contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com

### Cookies

A cookie is a string of information that a website stores on a visitor’s computer, and that the visitor’s browser provides to the website each time the visitor returns.

We use “cookies” to collect information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service.

### Are Cookies Used on the Site?

Cookies are used for a variety of reasons. We use Cookies to obtain information about the preferences of our Visitors and the services they select. We also use Cookies for security purposes to protect our Authorized Customers. For example, if an Authorized Customer is logged on and the site is unused for more than 10 minutes, we will automatically log the Authorized Customer off. Visitors who do not wish to have cookies placed on their computers should set their browsers to refuse cookies before using https://www.meridarealestategroup.com , with the drawback that certain features of website may not function properly without the aid of cookies.

### Cookies used by our service providers

Our service providers use cookies and those cookies may be stored on your computer when you visit our website. You can find more details about which cookies are used in our cookies info page.

### How does Merida Real Estate Group use login information?

Merida Real Estate Group uses login information, including, but not limited to, IP addresses, ISPs, and browser types, browser version, pages visited, date and time of visit, to analyze trends, administer the Site, track a user’s movement and use, and gather broad demographic information.

### What partners or service providers have access to Personally Identifiable Information from Visitors and/or Authorized Customers on the Site?

Merida Real Estate Group has entered into and will continue to enter into partnerships and other affiliations with a number of vendors. Such vendors may have access to certain Personally Identifiable Information on a need to know the basis for evaluating Authorized Customers for service eligibility. Our privacy policy does not cover their collection or use of this information.

### How does the Site keep Personally Identifiable Information secure?

All of our employees are familiar with our security policy and practices. The Personally Identifiable Information of our Visitors and Authorized Customers is only accessible to a limited number of qualified employees who are given a password in order to gain access to the information. We audit our security systems and processes on a regular basis. Sensitive information, such as credit card numbers or social security numbers, is protected by encryption protocols, in place to protect information sent over the Internet. While we take commercially reasonable measures to maintain a secure site, electronic communications and databases are subject to errors, tampering, and break-ins, and we cannot guarantee or warrant that such events will not take place and we will not be liable to Visitors or Authorized Customers for any such occurrences.

### How can Visitors correct any inaccuracies in Personally Identifiable Information?

Visitors and Authorized Customers may contact us to update Personally Identifiable Information about them or to correct any inaccuracies by emailing us at contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com .

### Can a Visitor delete or deactivate Personally Identifiable Information collected by the Site?

We provide Visitors and Authorized Customers with a mechanism to delete/deactivate Personally Identifiable Information from the Site’s database by contacting. However, because of backups and records of deletions, it may be impossible to delete a Visitor’s entry without retaining some residual information. An individual who requests to have Personally Identifiable Information deactivated will have this information functionally deleted, and we will not sell, transfer, or use Personally Identifiable Information relating to that individual in any way moving forward.

### Your rights

These are summarized rights that you have under data protection law

*   The right to access
*   The right to rectification
*   The right to erasure
*   The right to restrict processing
*   The right to object to processing
*   The right to data portability
*   The right to complain to a supervisory authority
*   The right to withdraw consent

### Children’s Privacy

Our Service does not address “Children”, anyone under the age of 18 years , and we do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 18 years.

If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with Personal Information, please get in touch with us immediately in the contact details provided. If we come to know that children below 18 years have provided personal information, we will delete the information from our servers immediately.

### Compliance With Laws

Disclosure of Personally Identifiable Information to comply with the law. We will disclose Personally Identifiable Information in order to comply with a court order or subpoena or a request from a law enforcement agency to release information. We will also disclose Personally Identifiable Information when reasonably necessary to protect the safety of our Visitors and Authorized Customers.

### What happens if the Privacy Policy Changes?

We will let our Visitors and Authorized Customers know about changes to our privacy policy by posting such changes on the Site. However, if we are changing our privacy policy in a manner that might cause disclosure of Personally Identifiable Information that a Visitor or Authorized Customer has previously requested not be disclosed, we will contact such Visitor or Authorized Customer to allow such Visitor or Authorized Customer to prevent such disclosure.

### Links

https://www.meridarealestategroup.com contains links to other websites. Please note that when you click on one of these links, you are moving to another website. We encourage you to read the privacy statements of these linked sites as their privacy policies may differ from ours.

### Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com

Why Live in Merida?
-------------------

Enjoy luxury living in one of the most beautiful colonial cities in Mexico. Known as the “cultural capital” of the Mexico Yucatan Peninsula, Merida is a vibrant, welcoming city 

Merida is known as _ciudad blanca_ (white city) because of the heavy use of white limestone as a building material, although as you roam the grid-like streets you can expect to find homes and shops decorated in delightful pastel colors.

Stroll down colorful streets, sip coffee in charming cafes, and spend your free time exploring the magnificent monuments and historic buildings. You’ll never run out of things to do in Merida! 

The Top 10 Best Things to Do in Merida
--------------------------------------

### 1\. Discover Local Yucatan Cuisine

Merida is home to some of the best food in Mexico, and while favorites like tacos and _elote_ (corn) Merida boasts some delicious regional dishes that are a must-try for any foodie.

With roots in Mayan cooking but heavily influenced by Europe, the Caribbean, and other regions throughout Mexico, Yucatan cuisine is unique, delicious, and distinctive from anywhere else in Mexico.

Some of our favorite dishes are:

*   **Huevos Motuleños:** a Yucatan specialty breakfast dish of fried eggs over black beans on a fried tortilla, served with salsa, plantains, chorizo, and queso fresco.
*   **Queso relleno:** a hollowed-out ball of Edam cheese filled with ground pork and smothered in gravy.
*   **Poc-chuc:** a traditional Mayan dish marinated of thinly-sliced pork marinated in sour orange juice and served with pickled onions.
*   **Cochinita pibil (Yucatán-style barbecued pork):** this dish of pulled pork shoulder marinated and braised in achiote paste, orange juice, and lime is perfect for tacos.

### 2\. Stroll the Boutiques at Casa Tho

Casa Tho Concept House is named after the Mayan name for Merida, T’hō, and is the perfect place to stroll around on a lazy afternoon.

This stunning renovated mansion offers a handful of boutique shops selling jewelry, clothing, perfumes, and more.

### 3\. Get Lost in the Lucas de Galvez Market Merida

Merida’s main market, the Lucas de Galvez market is a bustling market that dates back to the late 1800s when it was just a small shed.

Nowadays, the market is a sprawling, chaotic, and a great place to pick up fruits, vegetables, handmade local crafts, and lots more. 

### 4\. Celebrate at One of Merida’s Annual Festivals

Merida boasts a variety of annual festivals and events, including:

*   Merida Fest (January)
*   Carnival of Merida (February)
*   Semana Santa Processions (April)
*   La Noche Blanca (May)
*   Mexican Independence Day (September)
*   Day of the Dead (November)
*   Christmas (December)

These are just a handful of events and festivals you can enjoy living in Merida!

### 5\. Grab a Bite at Merida’s Restaurant Row

Located at the southern end of Paseo Montejo to Calle 47 (47th Street) you can find “restaurant row”, a stretch of places to eat and drink that will satisfy any appetite.

Some of our favorite restaurants include:

*   [Cafe Latte Quattro Sette](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d12103961-Reviews-Latte_Quattro_Sette-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-MYF7YpUpFBMQ6ZsIpNYqV)
    : A gorgeous coffee shop with decadent pastries.
*   [Catrin](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d13483140-Reviews-El_Catrin-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-OMpZ6rAQPopqNb2mPm3oA)
    : A hip gastropub with funky artwork on the walls
*   [Oliva Enoteca](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d7720030-Reviews-Oliva_Enoteca-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-ZmZxeFM7el7UPIPFemPAb)
    : An upscale Italian restaurant with a great wine list
*   [Amado by The Beer Box](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150811-d23193817-Reviews-Amado_By_The_Beer_Box-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html)
    : A beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant with live jazz several nights a week

### 6\. Go Organic at the Slow Food Market

Looking for a  more upscale farmer’s market experience? Then spend a Saturday strolling through the Slow Food Market.

It’s the perfect place to pick up organic meat, produce, as well as oils, fresh-baked goods, and other artisanal products.

### 7\. Join the BiciRuta

On Sunday mornings, both residents and tourists alike come out for a city-wide bike ride from 8 AM – 12 PM!

BiciRuta means “bike route’ is one of the most popular things to do in Merida, offering free bike and paid bike rentals as well as a chance to people-watch as you cruise around the city.

### 8\. Catch a Game of Pok Ta Pok

Pok Ta Pok is an ancient sport that is re-enacted every week in front of the Cathedral. Every Wednesday, head down to watch players fight it out to the sounds of traditional music.

The players slide along the cobblestones while attempting to score by hitting the ball into the post using just their hips. 

There’s no Pok Ta Pok league (the game is re-created for entertainment purposes) but that doesn’t mean that it isn’t a fun and exciting spectacle that you can catch every week while living in Merida.

### 9\. Grab a Drink (or Two, or Three)

Happy hour runs late in Merida, and there’s no shortage of places to grab cervezas, margaritas, micheladas, or palomas. You can even try pox (pronounced poche) which is a regional specialty drink made from corn.

If traditional cantinas aren’t your thing, there’s a growing craft beer scene with new options popping up in the centro all the time.

### 10\. Dance in the Streets During a Weekly Fiesta

There’s something to do every night in Merida! At night the city’s streets and plazas light up and come to life with dances, performances, concerts, and more. 

On weekends, several of the main streets are closed to traffic and street performers spill out into the streets. 

Featuring regional music and dance, these events are open to the public and are often lined with food trucks and pop-up stalls in case you feel hungry after dancing the night away.

### Living in Merida Mexico

Now that you’ve learned about all there is to see and do in Merida, it’s time to find your dream property! [Contact us today](https://www.meridarealestategroup.com/contact-us/)
 to enjoy luxury, upscale living in Merida, Mexico.

Why Live in Merida?
-------------------

Enjoy luxury living in one of the most beautiful colonial cities in Mexico. Known as the “cultural capital” of the Mexico Yucatan Peninsula, Merida is a vibrant, welcoming city 

Merida is known as _ciudad blanca_ (white city) because of the heavy use of white limestone as a building material, although as you roam the grid-like streets you can expect to find homes and shops decorated in delightful pastel colors.

Stroll down colorful streets, sip coffee in charming cafes, and spend your free time exploring the magnificent monuments and historic buildings. You’ll never run out of things to do in Merida! 

The Top 10 Best Things to Do in Merida
--------------------------------------

### 1\. Discover Local Yucatan Cuisine

Merida is home to some of the best food in Mexico, and while favorites like tacos and _elote_ (corn) Merida boasts some delicious regional dishes that are a must-try for any foodie.

With roots in Mayan cooking but heavily influenced by Europe, the Caribbean, and other regions throughout Mexico, Yucatan cuisine is unique, delicious, and distinctive from anywhere else in Mexico.

Some of our favorite dishes are:

*   **Huevos Motuleños:** a Yucatan specialty breakfast dish of fried eggs over black beans on a fried tortilla, served with salsa, plantains, chorizo, and queso fresco.
*   **Queso relleno:** a hollowed-out ball of Edam cheese filled with ground pork and smothered in gravy.
*   **Poc-chuc:** a traditional Mayan dish marinated of thinly-sliced pork marinated in sour orange juice and served with pickled onions.
*   **Cochinita pibil (Yucatán-style barbecued pork):** this dish of pulled pork shoulder marinated and braised in achiote paste, orange juice, and lime is perfect for tacos.

### 2\. Stroll the Boutiques at Casa Tho

Casa Tho Concept House is named after the Mayan name for Merida, T’hō, and is the perfect place to stroll around on a lazy afternoon.

This stunning renovated mansion offers a handful of boutique shops selling jewelry, clothing, perfumes, and more.

### 3\. Get Lost in the Lucas de Galvez Market Merida

Merida’s main market, the Lucas de Galvez market is a bustling market that dates back to the late 1800s when it was just a small shed.

Nowadays, the market is a sprawling, chaotic, and a great place to pick up fruits, vegetables, handmade local crafts, and lots more. 

### 4\. Celebrate at One of Merida’s Annual Festivals

Merida boasts a variety of annual festivals and events, including:

*   Merida Fest (January)
*   Carnival of Merida (February)
*   Semana Santa Processions (April)
*   La Noche Blanca (May)
*   Mexican Independence Day (September)
*   Day of the Dead (November)
*   Christmas (December)

These are just a handful of events and festivals you can enjoy living in Merida!

### 5\. Grab a Bite at Merida’s Restaurant Row

Located at the southern end of Paseo Montejo to Calle 47 (47th Street) you can find “restaurant row”, a stretch of places to eat and drink that will satisfy any appetite.

Some of our favorite restaurants include:

*   [Cafe Latte Quattro Sette](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d12103961-Reviews-Latte_Quattro_Sette-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-MYF7YpUpFBMQ6ZsIpNYqV)
    : A gorgeous coffee shop with decadent pastries.
*   [Catrin](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d13483140-Reviews-El_Catrin-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-OMpZ6rAQPopqNb2mPm3oA)
    : A hip gastropub with funky artwork on the walls
*   [Oliva Enoteca](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d7720030-Reviews-Oliva_Enoteca-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-ZmZxeFM7el7UPIPFemPAb)
    : An upscale Italian restaurant with a great wine list
*   [Amado by The Beer Box](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150811-d23193817-Reviews-Amado_By_The_Beer_Box-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html)
    : A beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant with live jazz several nights a week

### 6\. Go Organic at the Slow Food Market

Looking for a  more upscale farmer’s market experience? Then spend a Saturday strolling through the Slow Food Market.

It’s the perfect place to pick up organic meat, produce, as well as oils, fresh-baked goods, and other artisanal products.

### 7\. Join the BiciRuta

On Sunday mornings, both residents and tourists alike come out for a city-wide bike ride from 8 AM – 12 PM!

BiciRuta means “bike route’ is one of the most popular things to do in Merida, offering free bike and paid bike rentals as well as a chance to people-watch as you cruise around the city.

### 8\. Catch a Game of Pok Ta Pok

Pok Ta Pok is an ancient sport that is re-enacted every week in front of the Cathedral. Every Wednesday, head down to watch players fight it out to the sounds of traditional music.

The players slide along the cobblestones while attempting to score by hitting the ball into the post using just their hips. 

There’s no Pok Ta Pok league (the game is re-created for entertainment purposes) but that doesn’t mean that it isn’t a fun and exciting spectacle that you can catch every week while living in Merida.

### 9\. Grab a Drink (or Two, or Three)

Happy hour runs late in Merida, and there’s no shortage of places to grab cervezas, margaritas, micheladas, or palomas. You can even try pox (pronounced poche) which is a regional specialty drink made from corn.

If traditional cantinas aren’t your thing, there’s a growing craft beer scene with new options popping up in the centro all the time.

### 10\. Dance in the Streets During a Weekly Fiesta

There’s something to do every night in Merida! At night the city’s streets and plazas light up and come to life with dances, performances, concerts, and more. 

On weekends, several of the main streets are closed to traffic and street performers spill out into the streets. 

Featuring regional music and dance, these events are open to the public and are often lined with food trucks and pop-up stalls in case you feel hungry after dancing the night away.

Why Live in Merida?
-------------------

Enjoy luxury living in one of the most beautiful colonial cities in Mexico. Known as the “cultural capital” of the Mexico Yucatan Peninsula, Merida is a vibrant, welcoming city 

Merida is known as _ciudad blanca_ (white city) because of the heavy use of white limestone as a building material, although as you roam the grid-like streets you can expect to find homes and shops decorated in delightful pastel colors.

Stroll down colorful streets, sip coffee in charming cafes, and spend your free time exploring the magnificent monuments and historic buildings. You’ll never run out of things to do in Merida! 

The Top 10 Best Things to Do in Merida
--------------------------------------

### 1\. Discover Local Yucatan Cuisine

Merida is home to some of the best food in Mexico, and while favorites like tacos and _elote_ (corn) Merida boasts some delicious regional dishes that are a must-try for any foodie.

With roots in Mayan cooking but heavily influenced by Europe, the Caribbean, and other regions throughout Mexico, Yucatan cuisine is unique, delicious, and distinctive from anywhere else in Mexico.

Some of our favorite dishes are:

*   **Huevos Motuleños:** a Yucatan specialty breakfast dish of fried eggs over black beans on a fried tortilla, served with salsa, plantains, chorizo, and queso fresco.
*   **Queso relleno:** a hollowed-out ball of Edam cheese filled with ground pork and smothered in gravy.
*   **Poc-chuc:** a traditional Mayan dish marinated of thinly-sliced pork marinated in sour orange juice and served with pickled onions.
*   **Cochinita pibil (Yucatán-style barbecued pork):** this dish of pulled pork shoulder marinated and braised in achiote paste, orange juice, and lime is perfect for tacos.

### 2\. Stroll the Boutiques at Casa Tho

Casa Tho Concept House is named after the Mayan name for Merida, T’hō, and is the perfect place to stroll around on a lazy afternoon.

This stunning renovated mansion offers a handful of boutique shops selling jewelry, clothing, perfumes, and more.

### 3\. Get Lost in the Lucas de Galvez Market Merida

Merida’s main market, the Lucas de Galvez market is a bustling market that dates back to the late 1800s when it was just a small shed.

Nowadays, the market is a sprawling, chaotic, and a great place to pick up fruits, vegetables, handmade local crafts, and lots more. 

### 4\. Celebrate at One of Merida’s Annual Festivals

Merida boasts a variety of annual festivals and events, including:

*   Merida Fest (January)
*   Carnival of Merida (February)
*   Semana Santa Processions (April)
*   La Noche Blanca (May)
*   Mexican Independence Day (September)
*   Day of the Dead (November)
*   Christmas (December)

These are just a handful of events and festivals you can enjoy living in Merida!

### 5\. Grab a Bite at Merida’s Restaurant Row

Located at the southern end of Paseo Montejo to Calle 47 (47th Street) you can find “restaurant row”, a stretch of places to eat and drink that will satisfy any appetite.

Some of our favorite restaurants include:

*   [Cafe Latte Quattro Sette](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d12103961-Reviews-Latte_Quattro_Sette-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-MYF7YpUpFBMQ6ZsIpNYqV)
    : A gorgeous coffee shop with decadent pastries.
*   [Catrin](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d13483140-Reviews-El_Catrin-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-OMpZ6rAQPopqNb2mPm3oA)
    : A hip gastropub with funky artwork on the walls
*   [Oliva Enoteca](https://go.skimresources.com/?id=172087X1664748&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripadvisor.com%2FRestaurant_Review-g150811-d7720030-Reviews-Oliva_Enoteca-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html&xcust=things-to-do-in-merida-mexico_amcid-ZmZxeFM7el7UPIPFemPAb)
    : An upscale Italian restaurant with a great wine list
*   [Amado by The Beer Box](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150811-d23193817-Reviews-Amado_By_The_Beer_Box-Merida_Yucatan_Peninsula.html)
    : A beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant with live jazz several nights a week

### 6\. Go Organic at the Slow Food Market

Looking for a  more upscale farmer’s market experience? Then spend a Saturday strolling through the Slow Food Market.

It’s the perfect place to pick up organic meat, produce, as well as oils, fresh-baked goods, and other artisanal products.

### 7\. Join the BiciRuta

On Sunday mornings, both residents and tourists alike come out for a city-wide bike ride from 8 AM – 12 PM!

BiciRuta means “bike route’ is one of the most popular things to do in Merida, offering free bike and paid bike rentals as well as a chance to people-watch as you cruise around the city.

### 8\. Catch a Game of Pok Ta Pok

Pok Ta Pok is an ancient sport that is re-enacted every week in front of the Cathedral. Every Wednesday, head down to watch players fight it out to the sounds of traditional music.

The players slide along the cobblestones while attempting to score by hitting the ball into the post using just their hips. 

There’s no Pok Ta Pok league (the game is re-created for entertainment purposes) but that doesn’t mean that it isn’t a fun and exciting spectacle that you can catch every week while living in Merida.

### 9\. Grab a Drink (or Two, or Three)

Happy hour runs late in Merida, and there’s no shortage of places to grab cervezas, margaritas, micheladas, or palomas. You can even try pox (pronounced poche) which is a regional specialty drink made from corn.

If traditional cantinas aren’t your thing, there’s a growing craft beer scene with new options popping up in the centro all the time.

### 10\. Dance in the Streets During a Weekly Fiesta

There’s something to do every night in Merida! At night the city’s streets and plazas light up and come to life with dances, performances, concerts, and more. 

On weekends, several of the main streets are closed to traffic and street performers spill out into the streets. 

Featuring regional music and dance, these events are open to the public and are often lined with food trucks and pop-up stalls in case you feel hungry after dancing the night away.

### Living in Merida Mexico

Now that you’ve learned about all there is to see and do in Merida, it’s time to find your dream property! [Contact us today](https://www.meridarealestategroup.com/contact-us/)
 to enjoy luxury, upscale living in Merida, Mexico.

#### Overview

#### Property Description

Welcome to Crisanta, a remarkable new development nestled in the captivating region of Mococha, Yucatan. This visionary project is the result of meticulous financial analysis and reflects the booming real estate growth in Yucatan.

Following the upward trend of development towards the north of Mérida, Crisanta presents an exceptional investment opportunity, promising substantial appreciation due to its privileged location. Situated in the municipality of Mococha, just 20 minutes northeast of Mérida, this development offers semi-urbanized residential plots that embody the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience.

#### Property Description

Baura is a development of 38 apartments equipped with amenities located in Santa Gertrudis Copó.

It has models with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. All apartments on the ground floor have a pool and garden and those on the 1st and 2nd levels have a balcony.

Baura can be accessed by one of the most important roads in the city: the Manuel Berzunza Peripheral Ring.

Less than 10 minutes from large shopping malls such as La Isla, City Center, and Aqua Avenue (Coming soon)

The distribution of complex is divided into two towers (A and B) separated by the parking lot with an access and exit road.

Each tower consists of a ground floor and 2 levels. It has private parking for owners and three drawers for visitors outside the complex.

The typical architectural plan is divided into the following:

Tower A: 6 apartments with 2 bedrooms and 4 apartments with 1 bedroom

Tower B: 2 units of 3 bedrooms

The same distribution is repeated at levels 1 and 2.

On the ground floor are all the amenities.

In Tower A (the largest) there are 5 stair modules. Each module serves 4 departments (2 departments at level 1 and 2 departments at level 2)

In Tower B there are two apartments for each level. There is a stair module and elevator for the 4 apartments on levels 1 and 2.

Baura is a development of 38 apartments equipped with amenities located in Santa Gertrudis Copó.



It has models with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. All apartments on the ground floor have a pool and garden and those on the 1st and 2nd levels have a balcony.



Baura can be accessed by one of the most important roads in the city: the Manuel Berzunza Peripheral Ring.



Less than 10 minutes from large shopping malls such as La Isla, City Center, and Aqua Avenue (Coming soon)



The distribution of complex is divided into two towers (A and B) separated by the parking lot with an access and exit road.



Each tower consists of a ground floor and 2 levels. It has private parking for owners and three drawers for visitors outside the complex.



The typical architectural plan is divided into the following:



Tower A: 6 apartments with 2 bedrooms and 4 apartments with 1 bedroom



Tower B: 2 units of 3 bedrooms



The same distribution is repeated at levels 1 and 2.



On the ground floor are all the amenities.



In Tower A (the largest) there are 5 stair modules. Each module serves 4 departments (2 departments at level 1 and 2 departments at level 2)



In Tower B there are two apartments for each level. There is a stair module and elevator for the 4 apartments on levels 1 and 2.



Amenities:




Elevator



Social salon



Pool



Sports bar



Picnic area



Multipurpose area



Pet park



Vigilance booth

#### Property Description

Baura is a development of 38 apartments equipped with amenities located in Santa Gertrudis Copó.

It has models with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. All apartments on the ground floor have a pool and garden and those on the 1st and 2nd levels have a balcony.

Baura can be accessed by one of the most important roads in the city: the Manuel Berzunza Peripheral Ring.

Less than 10 minutes from large shopping malls such as La Isla, City Center, and Aqua Avenue (Coming soon)

The distribution of complex is divided into two towers (A and B) separated by the parking lot with an access and exit road.

Each tower consists of a ground floor and 2 levels. It has private parking for owners and three drawers for visitors outside the complex.

The typical architectural plan is divided into the following:

Tower A: 6 apartments with 2 bedrooms and 4 apartments with 1 bedroom

Tower B: 2 units of 3 bedrooms

The same distribution is repeated at levels 1 and 2.

On the ground floor are all the amenities.

In Tower A (the largest) there are 5 stair modules. Each module serves 4 departments (2 departments at level 1 and 2 departments at level 2)

In Tower B there are two apartments for each level. There is a stair module and elevator for the 4 apartments on levels 1 and 2.

Amenities:

*   Elevator
*   Social salon
*   Pool
*   Sports bar
*   Picnic area
*   Multipurpose area
*   Pet park
*   Vigilance booth

Baura is a development of 38 apartments equipped with amenities located in Santa Gertrudis Copó.



It has models with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. All apartments on the ground floor have a pool and garden and those on the 1st and 2nd levels have a balcony.



Baura can be accessed by one of the most important roads in the city: the Manuel Berzunza Peripheral Ring.



Less than 10 minutes from large shopping malls such as La Isla, City Center, and Aqua Avenue (Coming soon)



The distribution of complex is divided into two towers (A and B) separated by the parking lot with an access and exit road.



Each tower consists of a ground floor and 2 levels. It has private parking for owners and three drawers for visitors outside the complex.



The typical architectural plan is divided into the following:



Tower A: 6 apartments with 2 bedrooms and 4 apartments with 1 bedroom



Tower B: 2 units of 3 bedrooms



The same distribution is repeated at levels 1 and 2.



On the ground floor are all the amenities.



In Tower A (the largest) there are 5 stair modules. Each module serves 4 departments (2 departments at level 1 and 2 departments at level 2)



In Tower B there are two apartments for each level. There is a stair module and elevator for the 4 apartments on levels 1 and 2.



Amenities:




Elevator



Social salon



Pool



Sports bar



Picnic area



Multipurpose area



Pet park



Vigilance booth

#### Property Description

Introducing Sereniti, an exclusive and private vertical residential development located within Tamara, Merida’s most successful residential community. Sereniti offers 113 units spread across two towers, featuring six distinct apartment layouts catering to various needs and stages of life.

Nestled within the fully-gated Tamara community, Sereniti ensures absolute privacy. The development showcases organic urbanism, spacious living, and a lush landscape design that encourages an active, social, and outdoor lifestyle. Tamara features controlled access, surveillance, wide tree-lined avenues, jogging trails, and six thematic parks.

Why leave home when you can have everything at your doorstep?

Adjacent to the residential complex, Patio Central, a “Neighborhood Center,” is being built, allowing residents to walk or cycle to shops and services that make everyday life more comfortable and enjoyable.

Patio Central will include:

*   Café
*   Dry cleaner
*   Coworking and office spaces
*   Restaurant
*   Bank
*   Pharmacy
*   Supermarket

Experience a premium, integrated lifestyle at Sereniti, where each day presents new opportunities to enjoy sports and recreational activities within a vast, unique space. If you’re looking to make an excellent investment and enjoy a comfortable lifestyle with every convenience imaginable, choosing an apartment in Sereniti is your best decision.

Amenities that elevate your quality of life:

*   Motor lobby
*   Covered terrace
*   Gym
*   Paddle court
*   Coworking space
*   Lounge bar
*   Lobby with concierge service
*   Sundecks
*   Swimming pool
*   Grill and BBQ area
*   Gardens
*   Covered parking
*   Guest parking

Sereniti’s apartments include the following finishes and features:

Kitchen:

*   Fully-fitted kitchen
*   Stainless steel sink with mixer tap
*   Electric stove
*   Extractor hood
*   Granite countertops
*   Walnut-finished cabinets

Bathrooms:

*   Tempered glass enclosures
*   Bathroom furniture with walnut-finished cabinets
*   Marble countertops

Lighting and electrical:

*   Inverter mini-splits in the living room and bedrooms
*   LED lighting
*   Hydro-pneumatic water pressure

Floors and finishes:

*   Marble floors
*   Wood-like porcelain tile flooring on terraces
*   European-style aluminum windows
*   Fitted closets

Discover a new standard of living at Sereniti, where comfort, convenience, and a vibrant lifestyle come together in the heart of Merida’s thriving Tamara community.

#### Property Description

Introducing Sereniti, an exclusive and private vertical residential development located within Tamara, Merida’s most successful residential community. Sereniti offers 113 units spread across two towers, featuring six distinct apartment layouts catering to various needs and stages of life.

Nestled within the fully-gated Tamara community, Sereniti ensures absolute privacy. The development showcases organic urbanism, spacious living, and a lush landscape design that encourages an active, social, and outdoor lifestyle. Tamara features controlled access, surveillance, wide tree-lined avenues, jogging trails, and six thematic parks.

Why leave home when you can have everything at your doorstep?

Adjacent to the residential complex, Patio Central, a “Neighborhood Center,” is being built, allowing residents to walk or cycle to shops and services that make everyday life more comfortable and enjoyable.

Patio Central will include:

*   Café
*   Dry cleaner
*   Coworking and office spaces
*   Restaurant
*   Bank
*   Pharmacy
*   Supermarket

Experience a premium, integrated lifestyle at Sereniti, where each day presents new opportunities to enjoy sports and recreational activities within a vast, unique space. If you’re looking to make an excellent investment and enjoy a comfortable lifestyle with every convenience imaginable, choosing an apartment in Sereniti is your best decision.

Amenities that elevate your quality of life:

*   Motor lobby
*   Covered terrace
*   Gym
*   Paddle court
*   Coworking space
*   Lounge bar
*   Lobby with concierge service
*   Sundecks
*   Swimming pool
*   Grill and BBQ area
*   Gardens
*   Covered parking
*   Guest parking

Sereniti’s apartments include the following finishes and features:

Kitchen:

*   Fully-fitted kitchen
*   Stainless steel sink with mixer tap
*   Electric stove
*   Extractor hood
*   Granite countertops
*   Walnut-finished cabinets

Bathrooms:

*   Tempered glass enclosures
*   Bathroom furniture with walnut-finished cabinets
*   Marble countertops

Lighting and electrical:

*   Inverter mini-splits in the living room and bedrooms
*   LED lighting
*   Hydro-pneumatic water pressure

Floors and finishes:

*   Marble floors
*   Wood-like porcelain tile flooring on terraces
*   European-style aluminum windows
*   Fitted closets

Discover a new standard of living at Sereniti, where comfort, convenience, and a vibrant lifestyle come together in the heart of Merida’s thriving Tamara community.

#### Property Description

Introducing Compostela: Where Luxury Meets Comfort in Yucatan

Discover an exceptional living experience tailored to meet your every need at Compostela, an exquisite residential complex nestled in the heart of Yucatan. With its exclusive offering of 74 spacious residential lots, averaging 600 square meters each, and spanning across a sprawling 10-hectare area, Compostela sets the benchmark for luxury living in Merida. Immerse yourself in a world where contemporary architectural design, meticulous attention to detail, and expansive interiors come together to provide the comfort you truly deserve.

Compostela offers an array of unparalleled amenities and services, meticulously crafted to enhance your lifestyle and cater to the needs of your entire family. Enjoy the convenience of a concierge service that caters to your every request, while the efficient garbage collection and transportation services ensure a clean and organized living environment.

Embrace a world of leisure and recreation within the confines of Compostela. Indulge in the pleasures of the library, lose yourself in the captivating pages of literature, and expand your knowledge in an atmosphere of tranquility. The complex features controlled access 24/7, reinforced with advanced CCTV technology and an electric perimeter fence, ensuring the utmost safety and security for you and your loved ones.

Unwind in fully equipped parks that offer the perfect balance of relaxation and recreation. Embark on invigorating runs along the jogging track, while your children explore and play in the specially designed kids’ area. Bask in the beauty of meticulously planned landscape design that adds a touch of serenity to your everyday life. Every residential lot in Compostela is strategically positioned facing the park, ensuring unobstructed views and a sense of openness.

Stay seamlessly connected with Wi-Fi available throughout the development, enabling you to work, connect, and entertain with ease. Compostela’s Club House is the epitome of luxury and sophistication, offering a range of exceptional amenities. Engage in various activities at the Juniors club, conduct business with ease in the well-equipped business center, or relax in the inviting Motor lobby. Indulge in refined pleasures at the reception area, the bar, and cigar room, and savor exquisite dining experiences at the coffee and restaurant.

Experience a sense of community and togetherness at the kids’ club, while the swimming pools, including the adults, kids, and semi-Olympic pools, provide ample opportunities for relaxation and rejuvenation. Lounge in the sunbed area or unwind at the private bar with a terrace, offering a haven for leisurely moments. Stay fit and active in the state-of-the-art gym or engage in friendly competitions on the sports fields, featuring paddle, tennis, Fut 7, and basketball facilities. Host memorable events in the expansive events room accommodating up to 200 people or find inner peace in the outdoor yoga area.

Compostela also offers luxurious bathrooms and dressing rooms, complete with a sauna, steam room, massage room, and lockers, providing the ultimate retreat for relaxation and pampering.

Welcome to Compostela, where luxury, comfort, and unparalleled amenities await. Discover a lifestyle that surpasses all expectations and create cherished memories within the timeless elegance of this extraordinary residential complex.

Located on the stunning Yucatán Peninsula, with its tropical climate and crystal-clear waters, Mérida is one of the best regions to call home. The area boasts world-class infrastructure, making it easily accessible by land, sea, and air. Known for its high levels of safety, cleanliness, and ecological preservation, Mérida is a city where many families find their ideal lifestyle.



The northern part of Mérida is the fastest-growing area, with Temozón Norte standing out for its close proximity to essential services such as schools, universities, hospitals, and shopping centers. Just 30 minutes from the Yucatán coast, this area offers both the peace of a suburban lifestyle and quick access to beautiful beaches. As the community continues to modernize, property values in Temozón Norte are expected to rise, making it a prime area for investment.



TEMOZÓN 53 offers a serene environment while being close to the city's conveniences, improving your quality of life. Designed to accommodate a variety of lifestyles, TEMOZÓN 53 provides multiple models and living spaces to match your personal needs.



Exclusive amenities include a paddle tennis court, rooftop pool, coworking center, a welcoming lobby, and a rooftop terrace, ensuring that residents can enjoy recreation and relaxation year-round. The development also features a commercial area for added convenience.



TEMOZÓN 53 is the perfect place to enhance your lifestyle and grow within a thriving community.

#### Property Description

Introducing Elementa, a modern and innovative residential development in the vibrant city of Mérida. This exclusive community consists of 22 meticulously designed homes, each crafted to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings, offering an exceptional quality of life for you and your family.

Elementa’s homes are designed with both style and function in mind, featuring premium amenities such as covered garages, stunning rooftop gardens, and upper kitchen cabinetry. The secondary bedrooms come with elegant wooden closets, while the bathrooms are equipped with sleek tempered glass shower enclosures. The pergola-covered terrace provides a perfect outdoor space for relaxation or entertaining guests.

The development is distinguished by its 24/7 manned security booth, ensuring residents’ safety and peace of mind. Additional conveniences include a designated garbage disposal area, ample visitor parking, and individual walls for added privacy. The lush landscaping, accentuated by thoughtful exterior lighting, creates a peaceful and serene atmosphere.

Elementa also boasts an exclusive clubhouse, offering a space for social gatherings and leisure activities. Each home is designed with energy efficiency in mind, incorporating natural elements to enhance the living experience and reduce environmental impact.

At Elementa, you’ll find the perfect balance between contemporary living and the tranquility of nature. Don’t miss the opportunity to become part of this harmonious community in Mérida, where every detail is crafted to offer a serene and fulfilling lifestyle.

#### Property Description

Introducing Siela: A Luxurious Coastal Haven in Telchac Yucatan

Welcome to Siela, an extraordinary development nestled just minutes away from the vibrant city of Mérida in the picturesque Telchac Puerto. Set to become one of the most exclusive developments in the region, Siela boasts an enviable location overlooking the pristine Gulf of Mexico.

Meticulously designed, Siela offers a North-South orientation, granting breathtaking views of the sea and the lagoon while providing excellent natural ventilation. This thoughtful integration with the surrounding environment creates a perfect balance, seamlessly blending Siela into its idyllic surroundings.

Comprising 56 luxurious four-bedroom apartments across three distinctive models, Siela is housed in six exquisite towers, each equipped with an elevator for effortless access. The development also offers ample covered parking facilities, ensuring convenience and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Discover the captivating attractions near Siela that make living here truly special. Embark on a journey through history at the mesmerizing Ruins of Xcambó, soak up the vibrant ambiance of Telchac Puerto, savor delectable cuisine at the nearby marina and restaurants, unwind at the SILCER beach club, or indulge in the modern comforts of the Techno Hotel Beach.

Step into a world of indulgence with Siela’s exceptional amenities. Immerse yourself in the elegant lobby, stay active at the state-of-the-art gym, grab a quick snack at the inviting bar, and freshen up at the convenient restrooms. Enjoy direct access to 100 meters of pristine beach, unwind by the two sparkling pools, let your imagination run wild at the recreational area, and experience unforgettable moments at the rooftop bar and infinity pool.

Siela presents an array of luxurious models to choose from. With 46 lavish apartments and 10 stunning penthouses, each unit offers covered parking, private lockers, and the convenience of a private elevator shared by only two residences per level. Spanning five levels plus a breathtaking rooftop terrace, Siela’s three unique models provide an unparalleled oceanfront experience, ensuring that every resident enjoys awe-inspiring views of the majestic sea.

At Siela, life takes on a new dimension of luxury and tranquility. Immerse yourself in the charm of Telchac Yucatan, where coastal beauty and modern sophistication come together seamlessly. Indulge in the finer things in life and create cherished memories in this extraordinary development. Siela awaits to redefine your idea of coastal living.

#### Property Description

Introducing Sereniti, an exclusive and private vertical residential development located within Tamara, Merida’s most successful residential community. Sereniti offers 113 units spread across two towers, featuring six distinct apartment layouts catering to various needs and stages of life.

Nestled within the fully-gated Tamara community, Sereniti ensures absolute privacy. The development showcases organic urbanism, spacious living, and a lush landscape design that encourages an active, social, and outdoor lifestyle. Tamara features controlled access, surveillance, wide tree-lined avenues, jogging trails, and six thematic parks.

Why leave home when you can have everything at your doorstep?

Adjacent to the residential complex, Patio Central, a “Neighborhood Center,” is being built, allowing residents to walk or cycle to shops and services that make everyday life more comfortable and enjoyable.

Patio Central will include:

*   Café
*   Dry cleaner
*   Coworking and office spaces
*   Restaurant
*   Bank
*   Pharmacy
*   Supermarket

Experience a premium, integrated lifestyle at Sereniti, where each day presents new opportunities to enjoy sports and recreational activities within a vast, unique space. If you’re looking to make an excellent investment and enjoy a comfortable lifestyle with every convenience imaginable, choosing an apartment in Sereniti is your best decision.

Amenities that elevate your quality of life:

*   Motor lobby
*   Covered terrace
*   Gym
*   Paddle court
*   Coworking space
*   Lounge bar
*   Lobby with concierge service
*   Sundecks
*   Swimming pool
*   Grill and BBQ area
*   Gardens
*   Covered parking
*   Guest parking

Sereniti’s apartments include the following finishes and features:

Kitchen:

*   Fully-fitted kitchen
*   Stainless steel sink with mixer tap
*   Electric stove
*   Extractor hood
*   Granite countertops

#### Property Description

Soaring 16 stories above the sought-after Montebello neighborhood, Athena offers an unparalleled living experience in one of Merida’s most desirable areas. This exclusive residential development spans 6,000 m² and features 80 modern apartments with breathtaking views of Montebello and the surrounding urban landscape.

Designed for those who seek a blend of luxury and convenience, Athena provides a vibrant lifestyle where residents can live, work, and indulge in the heart of the city. Just steps away from Merida’s finest offerings, Athena is the perfect address for those who appreciate modern urban living.

With nine distinct apartment layouts, Athena offers options for every lifestyle. Choose from one, two, or three-bedroom apartments, each with a private terrace and expansive views of the city’s northern skyline. Penthouses with rooftop amenities offer ultimate luxury, ranging from 405.72 to 695.91 m².

**Amenities at Athena are designed to elevate your lifestyle:**

*   Grand motor lobby
*   Dedicated concierge services
*   Elevators for seamless access
*   Reception area with a welcoming ambiance
*   Coworking space and meeting rooms
*   Events salon for hosting gatherings
*   Lounge bar and game room for relaxation
*   Cinema room for immersive entertainment
*   Terrace with sunbathing areas
*   Sparkling pool and kids’ pool
*   Swimming lane for fitness
*   Jacuzzis and sauna for relaxation
*   Children’s playground and kid’s club
*   Grill area and roof bar with panoramic views
*   Sky lounge for social gatherings
*   Lush green areas for outdoor enjoyment
*   24/7 CCTV surveillance and underground parking

Athena combines architectural brilliance with thoughtful amenities to create an extraordinary living experience. Located in the heart of Montebello, this development is perfect for those seeking a dynamic yet serene lifestyle in Merida.

og:description: Discover Athena 1 Bedroom Condo, a 1445 ft², 1 Bed Condo located in Montebello Merida, priced at $358424 USD. HOA/Maintenance: $335 USD/Month

Soaring 16 stories above the sought-after Montebello neighborhood, Athena offers an unparalleled living experience in one of Merida’s most desirable areas. This exclusive residential development spans 6,000 m² and features 80 modern apartments with breathtaking views of Montebello and the surrounding urban landscape.



Designed for those who seek a blend of luxury and convenience, Athena provides a vibrant lifestyle where residents can live, work, and indulge in the heart of the city. Just steps away from Merida’s finest offerings, Athena is the perfect address for those who appreciate modern urban living.



With nine distinct apartment layouts, Athena offers options for every lifestyle. Choose from one, two, or three-bedroom apartments, each with a private terrace and expansive views of the city’s northern skyline. Penthouses with rooftop amenities offer ultimate luxury, ranging from 405.72 to 695.91 m².



Amenities at Athena are designed to elevate your lifestyle:




Grand motor lobby



Dedicated concierge services



Elevators for seamless access



Reception area with a welcoming ambiance



Coworking space and meeting rooms



Events salon for hosting gatherings



Lounge bar and game room for relaxation



Cinema room for immersive entertainment



Terrace with sunbathing areas



Sparkling pool and kids’ pool



Swimming lane for fitness



Jacuzzis and sauna for relaxation



Children's playground and kid’s club



Grill area and roof bar with panoramic views



Sky lounge for social gatherings



Lush green areas for outdoor enjoyment



24/7 CCTV surveillance and underground parking




Athena combines architectural brilliance with thoughtful amenities to create an extraordinary living experience. Located in the heart of Montebello, this development is perfect for those seeking a dynamic yet serene lifestyle in Merida.

Introducing Taliva, a harmonious blend of comfort, modernity, and elegance in the heart of Merida City's most exclusive neighborhood, Montes de Amé. This remarkable residential development promises a unique living experience for those seeking long-term profitability and security in their investment. Don't wait any longer – discover Taliva today!



At Taliva, our thoughtfully designed apartments provide the perfect canvas for your distinctive lifestyle. Revel in the sophisticated ambiance and immerse yourself in a community that epitomizes the essence of refined living.



Taliva's carefully curated amenities ensure a truly unparalleled experience:




Gated Entrance: Enjoy peace of mind with secure access and round-the-clock surveillance.



Elevator: Experience the convenience of effortless mobility throughout the building.



Rooftop: Enjoy stunning panoramic views and unwind at our inviting rooftop retreat, perfect for relaxation and socializing.



Green Spaces: Breath in tranquility amidst lush, landscaped gardens that provide a serene oasis in the city's heart.



Bar: Indulge in a carefully crafted drink selection at our stylish on-site bar, the ideal spot for casual gatherings or celebratory occasions.



Lounge Chairs: Relax in ultimate comfort with our plush lounge seating, designed for leisurely afternoons and memorable evenings.




Experience the pinnacle of contemporary living at Taliva, where elegance and modernity converge to create a truly extraordinary residential community. Visit us today and enter a world of unparalleled sophistication in Merida City's Montes de Amé.

Welcome to Puerto Carey, the epitome of fresh and innovative real estate development in the vibrant coastal town of Chelem, Yucatan. Situated in one of the most sought-after areas within the bustling port of Progreso, Puerto Carey brings forth a harmonious fusion of modern living and commercial convenience. This exceptional project not only offers an integrated lifestyle but also presents an unparalleled investment opportunity, making it the ultimate choice for astute investors.



Immerse yourself in the enchanting ambiance of Puerto Lindo, an exclusive mega-development in Chelem. Designed to encompass multiple private communities, each with its own distinctive character, this extraordinary project is adorned with lush green spaces, recreational areas, and exclusive amenities, enabling you to embrace and savor the essence of tropical living. Boasting a strategic location along the renowned Emerald Coast, Puerto Lindo provides an idyllic setting for residents to revel in the beauty of their surroundings.



At Puerto Carey, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional quality in construction and finishes, setting the standard for luxurious living in Chelem. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in every detail, ensuring that your dream home is crafted with meticulous attention to detail. With superb infrastructure and seamless accessibility, you will enjoy unparalleled convenience and connectivity within the thriving port of Chelem.



Indulge in the diverse housing options available at Puerto Carey, where a mixed-model approach combines contemporary flats with a vibrant shopping area. This unique combination creates a dynamic environment that not only caters to your residential needs but also offers a wealth of commercial opportunities. Embrace the convenience of having a range of amenities and services right at your doorstep, enhancing your lifestyle and providing endless possibilities for growth and prosperity.



Puerto Carey serves as a beacon for investors seeking to capitalize on real estate capital gains. With its innovative mixed-model approach and strategic location, it presents an enticing investment prospect for discerning individuals looking to expand their portfolio. As the focal point for various types of investors, Puerto Carey offers the promise of long-term growth and returns.



Don't miss your chance to be a part of this extraordinary development. Puerto Carey invites you to embark on a journey of integrated living, where convenience, luxury, and investment potential converge. Embrace the vibrant spirit of Chelem and experience a lifestyle beyond compare. Secure your future and make Puerto Carey your home today.
