og:description: Discover Flow Living 2 Story 2 Bed Condo, a 850 ft², located in Temozón , priced at $142146 USD. HOA/Maintenance: $120 USD/Month

FLOW is a collaboration of two renowned Yucatecan law firms' architecture, internationally awarded: Arkham Projects and Essential Estudio.



With the objective of designing simple but with features necessary to put it in different architecture award competitions.



Investing in flow is investing in a project that will be internationally recognized for its great design.



FLOW LIVING is a development for residential use consisting of 9 apartments with exclusive designs distributed on 3 levels located behind the Marista University, with direct access to the highway Progress that in the same way is a few meters from the UVM and the Anáhuac Mayab, making this the ideal place for students, newly married couples and executives.



The apartments have a Roof Garden, central patio, outdoor seating area, and 11 storage drawers parking lot.



Amenities:




Main garden



Rooftop



Grill area



24/7 security



Electric access



Access booth

Experience the exceptional quality of life in Mérida, Yucatán, one of the safest cities in the country. *   Automated irrigation system for green spaces and a dedicated area for trash disposal
*   Water pressurization throughout the complex
*   Fully equipped apartments ready for delivery

Invest in Tura and enjoy the benefits of modern living in one of Mérida’s best neighborhoods.

Introducing Sereniti, an exclusive and private vertical residential development located within Tamara, Merida’s most successful residential community. Sereniti offers 113 units spread across two towers, featuring six distinct apartment layouts catering to various needs and stages of life.

Tamara features controlled access, surveillance, wide tree-lined avenues, jogging trails, and six thematic parks.

Why leave home when you can have everything at your doorstep?

Adjacent to the residential complex, Patio Central, a “Neighborhood Center,” is being built, allowing residents to walk or cycle to shops and services that make everyday life more comfortable and enjoyable.

Patio Central will include:

*   Café
*   Dry cleaner
*   Coworking and office spaces
*   Restaurant
*   Bank
*   Pharmacy
*   Supermarket

Experience a premium, integrated lifestyle at Sereniti, where each day presents new opportunities to enjoy sports and recreational activities within a vast, unique space. If you’re looking to make an excellent investment and enjoy a comfortable lifestyle with every convenience imaginable, choosing an apartment in Sereniti is your best decision.

Amenities that elevate your quality of life:

*   Motor lobby
*   Covered terrace
*   Gym
*   Paddle court
*   Coworking space
*   Lounge bar
*   Lobby with concierge service
*   Sundecks
*   Swimming pool
*   Grill and BBQ area
*   Gardens
*   Covered parking
*   Guest parking

Sereniti’s apartments include the following finishes and features:

Kitchen:

*   Fully-fitted kitchen
*   Stainless steel sink with mixer tap
*   Electric stove
*   Extractor hood
*   Granite countertops
*   Walnut-finished cabinets

Bathrooms:

*   Tempered glass enclosures
*   Bathroom furniture with walnut-finished cabinets
*   Marble countertops

Lighting and electrical:

*   Inverter mini-splits in the living room and bedrooms
*   LED lighting
*   Hydro-pneumatic water pressure

Floors and finishes:

*   Marble floors
*   Wood-like porcelain tile flooring on terraces
*   European-style aluminum windows
*   Fitted closets

Discover a new standard of living at Sereniti, where comfort, convenience, and a vibrant lifestyle come together in the heart of Merida’s thriving Tamara community.

og:description: Discover Mio Apartments in Merida’s Montebello—urban living meets nature with amenities like a gym, garden, and grill area. Enjoy a vibrant yet tranquil lifestyle in a prime location.

Mio condos offer a perfect blend of urban living and natural surroundings, designed to complement a modern lifestyle. Located on the prestigious Avenida 10 de Montebello, in one of Merida’s most desirable neighborhoods, Mio connects you seamlessly with both nature and the city. Wake up to views of the green horizon and the gentle hum of the city below, creating a tranquil yet vibrant atmosphere.



Mio’s strategic location makes every aspect of life more convenient—whether it’s a spontaneous trip to the beach or cenotes, or a quick dinner at a nearby restaurant. Montebello's thoughtful design prioritizes comfort and style, offering spaces tailored to your needs, combining essentials with refined design to create a harmonious living environment.



With amenities such as a workspace, gym, garden, grill area, and lobby, Mio Apartments provide the perfect backdrop for starting a new chapter in your life.

#### Property Description

More than a place, Enso is a state of mind and a lifestyle. It is the material expression of a free and creative vision with oriental roots, where the beauty of natural elements, the discreet elegance of simple lines and volumes, and the serene luxury of simplicity are valued.

Enso is calm, but also the impulse in the search for inner balance, the natural path to achieve the full enjoyment of personal well-being. Therefore, it is the destiny of Enso to mark a before and after in housing developments in Mérida, defining the category of architectural craftsmanship.

Mérida, the capital of the state of Yucatán, is the heart of southeastern Mexico and concentrates the complete range of commercial, logistical, educational, recreational, and health services, among others.

The so-called White City is today one of the entities with the highest rates of safety and quality of life in Mexico, comparable even to some Scandinavian cities. 

The northern area of ​​Mérida is today the one with the most significant added value and development in the city. Through its unbeatable connectivity, it is the gateway to the most exclusive services and a wide variety of entertainment options. 

Right here, in an area of ​​more than 15,000 m2, Enso is born, a vertical housing project that will soon redefine its surroundings and is called to be the most iconic green lung in the area.

Since its very conception, Enso has been faithful to immutable design principles, in perfect harmony with a sustainable spirit expressed through the implementation of eco techniques.

In Enso, every day its inhabitants will design their own life experiences. For this, they have at their disposal a range of exclusive services and amenities that promote coexistence or, the enjoyment of ideal spaces for meeting oneself.

Enso is calm, but also the impulse in the search for inner balance, the natural path to achieve the full enjoyment of personal well-being. Therefore, it is the destiny of Enso to mark a before and after in housing developments in Mérida, defining the category of architectural craftsmanship.



Mérida, the capital of the state of Yucatán, is the heart of southeastern Mexico and concentrates the complete range of commercial, logistical, educational, recreational, and health services, among others.



The so-called White City is today one of the entities with the highest rates of safety and quality of life in Mexico, comparable even to some Scandinavian cities. 



The northern area of ​​Mérida is today the one with the most significant added value and development in the city. Through its unbeatable connectivity, it is the gateway to the most exclusive services and a wide variety of entertainment options. 



Right here, in an area of ​​more than 15,000 m2, Enso is born, a vertical housing project that will soon redefine its surroundings and is called to be the most iconic green lung in the area.



Since its very conception, Enso has been faithful to immutable design principles, in perfect harmony with a sustainable spirit expressed through the implementation of eco techniques.



In Enso, every day its inhabitants will design their own life experiences. For this, they have at their disposal a range of exclusive services and amenities that promote coexistence or, the enjoyment of ideal spaces for meeting oneself.

og:description: Discover Taliva 1 Bedroom Condo, a 662 ft², 1 Bed Condo located in Montes De Ame Merida, priced at $153417 USD. HOA/Maintenance: $95 USD/Month

Introducing Taliva, a harmonious blend of comfort, modernity, and elegance in the heart of Merida City's most exclusive neighborhood, Montes de Amé. This remarkable residential development promises a unique living experience for those seeking long-term profitability and security in their investment. Don't wait any longer – discover Taliva today!



At Taliva, our thoughtfully designed apartments provide the perfect canvas for your distinctive lifestyle. Revel in the sophisticated ambiance and immerse yourself in a community that epitomizes the essence of refined living.



Taliva's carefully curated amenities ensure a truly unparalleled experience:




Gated Entrance: Enjoy peace of mind with secure access and round-the-clock surveillance.



Elevator: Experience the convenience of effortless mobility throughout the building.



Rooftop: Enjoy stunning panoramic views and unwind at our inviting rooftop retreat, perfect for relaxation and socializing.



Green Spaces: Breath in tranquility amidst lush, landscaped gardens that provide a serene oasis in the city's heart.



Bar: Indulge in a carefully crafted drink selection at our stylish on-site bar, the ideal spot for casual gatherings or celebratory occasions.



Lounge Chairs: Relax in ultimate comfort with our plush lounge seating, designed for leisurely afternoons and memorable evenings.




Experience the pinnacle of contemporary living at Taliva, where elegance and modernity converge to create a truly extraordinary residential community. Visit us today and enter a world of unparalleled sophistication in Merida City's Montes de Amé.

#### Property Description

Mio condos offer a perfect blend of urban living and natural surroundings, designed to complement a modern lifestyle. Located on the prestigious Avenida 10 de Montebello, in one of Merida’s most desirable neighborhoods, Mio connects you seamlessly with both nature and the city. Wake up to views of the green horizon and the gentle hum of the city below, creating a tranquil yet vibrant atmosphere.

Mio’s strategic location makes every aspect of life more convenient—whether it’s a spontaneous trip to the beach or cenotes, or a quick dinner at a nearby restaurant. Montebello’s thoughtful design prioritizes comfort and style, offering spaces tailored to your needs, combining essentials with refined design to create a harmonious living environment.

With amenities such as a workspace, gym, garden, grill area, and lobby, Mio Apartments provide the perfect backdrop for starting a new chapter in your life.

Mio condos offer a perfect blend of urban living and natural surroundings, designed to complement a modern lifestyle. Located on the prestigious Avenida 10 de Montebello, in one of Merida’s most desirable neighborhoods, Mio connects you seamlessly with both nature and the city. Wake up to views of the green horizon and the gentle hum of the city below, creating a tranquil yet vibrant atmosphere.



Mio’s strategic location makes every aspect of life more convenient—whether it’s a spontaneous trip to the beach or cenotes, or a quick dinner at a nearby restaurant. Montebello's thoughtful design prioritizes comfort and style, offering spaces tailored to your needs, combining essentials with refined design to create a harmonious living environment.



With amenities such as a workspace, gym, garden, grill area, and lobby, Mio Apartments provide the perfect backdrop for starting a new chapter in your life.

#### Property Description

More than a place, Enso is a state of mind and a lifestyle. It is the material expression of a free and creative vision with oriental roots, where the beauty of natural elements, the discreet elegance of simple lines and volumes, and the serene luxury of simplicity are valued.

Enso is calm, but also the impulse in the search for inner balance, the natural path to achieve the full enjoyment of personal well-being. Therefore, it is the destiny of Enso to mark a before and after in housing developments in Mérida, defining the category of architectural craftsmanship.

Mérida, the capital of the state of Yucatán, is the heart of southeastern Mexico and concentrates the complete range of commercial, logistical, educational, recreational, and health services, among others.

The so-called White City is today one of the entities with the highest rates of safety and quality of life in Mexico, comparable even to some Scandinavian cities. 

The northern area of ​​Mérida is today the one with the most significant added value and development in the city. Through its unbeatable connectivity, it is the gateway to the most exclusive services and a wide variety of entertainment options. 

Right here, in an area of ​​more than 15,000 m2, Enso is born, a vertical housing project that will soon redefine its surroundings and is called to be the most iconic green lung in the area.

Since its very conception, Enso has been faithful to immutable design principles, in perfect harmony with a sustainable spirit expressed through the implementation of eco techniques.

In Enso, every day its inhabitants will design their own life experiences. For this, they have at their disposal a range of exclusive services and amenities that promote coexistence or, the enjoyment of ideal spaces for meeting oneself.

More than a place, Enso is a state of mind and a lifestyle. It is the material expression of a free and creative vision with oriental roots, where the beauty of natural elements, the discreet elegance of simple lines and volumes, and the serene luxury of simplicity are valued.



Enso is calm, but also the impulse in the search for inner balance, the natural path to achieve the full enjoyment of personal well-being. Therefore, it is the destiny of Enso to mark a before and after in housing developments in Mérida, defining the category of architectural craftsmanship.



Mérida, the capital of the state of Yucatán, is the heart of southeastern Mexico and concentrates the complete range of commercial, logistical, educational, recreational, and health services, among others.



The so-called White City is today one of the entities with the highest rates of safety and quality of life in Mexico, comparable even to some Scandinavian cities. 



The northern area of ​​Mérida is today the one with the most significant added value and development in the city. Through its unbeatable connectivity, it is the gateway to the most exclusive services and a wide variety of entertainment options. 



Right here, in an area of ​​more than 15,000 m2, Enso is born, a vertical housing project that will soon redefine its surroundings and is called to be the most iconic green lung in the area.



Since its very conception, Enso has been faithful to immutable design principles, in perfect harmony with a sustainable spirit expressed through the implementation of eco techniques.



In Enso, every day its inhabitants will design their own life experiences. For this, they have at their disposal a range of exclusive services and amenities that promote coexistence or, the enjoyment of ideal spaces for meeting oneself.

#### Property Description

Baura is a development of 38 apartments equipped with amenities located in Santa Gertrudis Copó.

It has models with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. All apartments on the ground floor have a pool and garden and those on the 1st and 2nd levels have a balcony.

Baura can be accessed by one of the most important roads in the city: the Manuel Berzunza Peripheral Ring.

Less than 10 minutes from large shopping malls such as La Isla, City Center, and Aqua Avenue (Coming soon)

The distribution of complex is divided into two towers (A and B) separated by the parking lot with an access and exit road.

Each tower consists of a ground floor and 2 levels. It has private parking for owners and three drawers for visitors outside the complex.

The typical architectural plan is divided into the following:

Tower A: 6 apartments with 2 bedrooms and 4 apartments with 1 bedroom

Tower B: 2 units of 3 bedrooms

The same distribution is repeated at levels 1 and 2.

On the ground floor are all the amenities.

In Tower A (the largest) there are 5 stair modules. Each module serves 4 departments (2 departments at level 1 and 2 departments at level 2)

In Tower B there are two apartments for each level. There is a stair module and elevator for the 4 apartments on levels 1 and 2.

Baura is a development of 38 apartments equipped with amenities located in Santa Gertrudis Copó.



It has models with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. All apartments on the ground floor have a pool and garden and those on the 1st and 2nd levels have a balcony.



Baura can be accessed by one of the most important roads in the city: the Manuel Berzunza Peripheral Ring.



Less than 10 minutes from large shopping malls such as La Isla, City Center, and Aqua Avenue (Coming soon)



The distribution of complex is divided into two towers (A and B) separated by the parking lot with an access and exit road.



Each tower consists of a ground floor and 2 levels. It has private parking for owners and three drawers for visitors outside the complex.



The typical architectural plan is divided into the following:



Tower A: 6 apartments with 2 bedrooms and 4 apartments with 1 bedroom



Tower B: 2 units of 3 bedrooms



The same distribution is repeated at levels 1 and 2.



On the ground floor are all the amenities.



In Tower A (the largest) there are 5 stair modules. Each module serves 4 departments (2 departments at level 1 and 2 departments at level 2)



In Tower B there are two apartments for each level. There is a stair module and elevator for the 4 apartments on levels 1 and 2.



Amenities:




Elevator



Social salon



Pool



Sports bar



Picnic area



Multipurpose area



Pet park



Vigilance booth

Introducing Athena: A Captivating New Development in Merida



Nestled in the coveted neighborhood of Montebello, Athena stands tall, soaring 16 stories above a sprawling 6,000 m2 land, offering 80 apartments with awe-inspiring views of the urban landscape of Montebello and its surrounding areas. 



This exceptional real estate project is designed to provide a lifestyle of exclusivity, where residents can live, work, and indulge in the most sought-after district in the city.



At Athena, you'll find everything that makes Merida great, just steps away.



Featuring nine different types of apartments, Athena caters to all styles of living:




One, two, and three-bedroom apartments



Each apartment boasts a terrace with stunning views of the city's northern skyline



Ranging from 134.30 to 299.47 m2



Three-bedroom penthouses with rooftop amenities



Two models are available, ranging from 405.72 to 695.91 m2




Enjoy a wealth of amenities that elevate your living experience at Athena:



• Motor lobby for a grand entrance 



• Dedicated concierge services for personalized assistance 



• Elevators for convenient access 



• Reception area with a welcoming ambiance 



• Coworking space and meeting rooms for productive work sessions 



• Events salon for hosting memorable gatherings 



• Lounge bar for socializing and relaxation 



• Game room for entertainment and leisure 



• Cinema room for immersive movie experiences 



• Terrace with sunbathing area for outdoor enjoyment 



• Sparkling swimming pool for refreshing dips 



• Kids pool for safe water play 



• Swimming lane for fitness enthusiasts 



• Jacuzzis for ultimate relaxation 



• Children's playground for little ones to have fun 



• Well-appointed bathrooms and changing rooms 



• State-of-the-art gym for staying active and fit 



• Sauna for rejuvenating spa-like experiences 



• Kid's club to keep the young ones engaged 



• Grill area for sizzling outdoor barbecues 



• Roof bar with panoramic views for indulgent evenings 



• Sky lounge for elevated socializing 



• Lush green areas for tranquil strolls and outdoor activities 



• 24/7 CCTV surveillance for enhanced security 



• Underground parking for convenience and safety



Come experience the epitome of modern living at Athena, where architectural brilliance and a vibrant community blend seamlessly to create an extraordinary lifestyle in the heart of Merida's most desirable location.

#### Property Description

Introducing Sodzil 324: a fresh, vibrant, and modern residential development in Merida’s most sought-after neighborhood. 

This upscale community offers residents an unparalleled urban living experience, just steps from the city’s top amenities and surrounded by lush greenery.

Sodzil 324 is located within Merida’s prime suburban perimeter, offering easy access to gourmet restaurants, trendy bars, state-of-the-art gyms, corporate offices, shopping plazas, and more. Stay active with functional training, spinning, and cycling options, or nurture your mind at nearby universities and private schools. 

For your daily needs, artisanal bakeries, supermarkets, convenience stores, and high-end hotels are just a short stroll away. Pet-friendly cafés and a 24-hour gym cater to your every need, while wide avenues, beauty salons, and a commercial zone with a brewery and liquor store keep you entertained.

Choose from three beautifully designed apartment options, each featuring a spacious living room, dining room, and kitchen. 

Every apartment includes custom cabinetry in the closets and kitchens, ensuring a sleek and functional space to call home.

Apartment Standard C: This 68.64 m² apartment boasts a bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, a guest half-bathroom, and a balcony. Enjoy an additional 3.96 m² of the terrace and 1.65 m² of green space. Comes with one parking space.

Apartment Standard D: This 68.64 m² apartment features a bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, and a guest half-bathroom. It includes 3.30 m² of green space and one parking space.

Apartment Standard E: With 75.25 m² of living space, this apartment offers a bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, and a guest half-bathroom. Enjoy 1.65 m² of green space and one parking space.

At Sodzil 324, experience a sophisticated and thriving lifestyle, where every convenience is just moments away. Don’t miss your chance to be part of this dynamic new community in Merida’s most desirable location.

Introducing Sodzil 324: a fresh, vibrant, and modern residential development in Merida's most sought-after neighborhood. 



This upscale community offers residents an unparalleled urban living experience, just steps from the city's top amenities and surrounded by lush greenery.



Sodzil 324 is located within Merida's prime suburban perimeter, offering easy access to gourmet restaurants, trendy bars, state-of-the-art gyms, corporate offices, shopping plazas, and more. Stay active with functional training, spinning, and cycling options, or nurture your mind at nearby universities and private schools. 



For your daily needs, artisanal bakeries, supermarkets, convenience stores, and high-end hotels are just a short stroll away. Pet-friendly cafés and a 24-hour gym cater to your every need, while wide avenues, beauty salons, and a commercial zone with a brewery and liquor store keep you entertained.



Choose from three beautifully designed apartment options, each featuring a spacious living room, dining room, and kitchen. 



Every apartment includes custom cabinetry in the closets and kitchens, ensuring a sleek and functional space to call home.



Apartment Standard C: This 68.64 m² apartment boasts a bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, a guest half-bathroom, and a balcony. Enjoy an additional 3.96 m² of the terrace and 1.65 m² of green space. Comes with one parking space.



Apartment Standard D: This 68.64 m² apartment features a bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, and a guest half-bathroom. It includes 3.30 m² of green space and one parking space.



Apartment Standard E: With 75.25 m² of living space, this apartment offers a bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, and a guest half-bathroom. Enjoy 1.65 m² of green space and one parking space.



At Sodzil 324, experience a sophisticated and thriving lifestyle, where every convenience is just moments away. Don't miss your chance to be part of this dynamic new community in Merida's most desirable location.

Service room with a full bathroom.

Additional full bathroom.



Guest bedroom for visiting family and friends.



Inviting swimming pool for relaxation and enjoyment.



Efficient irrigation system for maintaining the lush green surroundings.

Gray hammered concrete.



Chukum, a traditional Mayan stucco.



Polished concrete.

Granite-drainboard combo for added convenience.

40 x 20 cm natural stone columns.



Polished concrete walls.



Marmol Friorito Travertine floors.



High-quality pine wood doors.

Cozy TV room.

Bedroom 2 with an area for a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom.

Welcoming entrance.



Full bathroom.



Spacious living and dining area.



Fully equipped kitchen.



Ample pantry.



Study room with a full bathroom.

Laundry area.

Terrace for outdoor relaxation.



Chukum-finished swimming pool.



Two-car carport with a polycarbonate roof.

#### Property Description

Welcome to Casa Kaab, a sanctuary designed to offer your family a safe, comfortable, and peaceful living experience, surrounded by nature. This stunning residence is thoughtfully crafted to ensure a serene lifestyle in every detail.

**Ground Floor Features:**

*   Spacious living room
*   Elegant foyer
*   Dining room perfect for gatherings
*   Modern kitchen
*   Convenient half bathroom
*   Service room with its own bathroom
*   Laundry area

**Interior Design:** Casa Kaab showcases high-quality craftsmanship, with block walls finished in three layers of rich patch and stucco, topped with a final coating of sealant and two coats of white vinyl paint. The second-floor showers are finished with polished Veracruz marble, adding a touch of luxury, while the exterior staircase wall is accentuated with 15cm stone slabs for a natural, rustic charm.

**Flooring:**

*   Interior floors feature 60x60cm rectified porcelain tiles by Interceramic in Absolute Beige, with White Pearl grout for a clean, polished look.
*   Outdoor areas, including terraces and the entrance, are finished with 60x60cm non-slip ceramic tiles by Interceramic in the Habitad Canvas model, also paired with White Pearl grout for continuity.

**Equipment:**

*   43-gallon Frankilinde hydropneumatic tank for optimal water pressure
*   Biodigester for efficient wastewater management
*   12-meter well for pool drainage
*   18-meter deep well with a submersible pump for the house and pool

**Location:** Casa Kaab is located in the exclusive Paseos del Mayab community, nestled in the rapidly growing area of Conkal. Its prime location offers easy access to top-notch services, schools, and key areas of the city, making it a perfect choice for modern family living.

Casa Kaab combines elegance, practicality, and tranquility to create your ideal family home. Experience the perfect balance of luxury and comfort—your dream home awaits at Casa Kaab.

#### Property Description

Introducing Malma Homes, the epitome of quality living and comfort for you and your family. Nestled within the prestigious gated community of Nadira in Conkal, these stunning homes are situated in a rapidly developing area, ensuring a solid investment. Enjoy seamless connectivity to the best city services, as well as access to popular shopping and entertainment hotspots.

Step into your Malma Home and embrace a spacious open floor plan. The ground floor features a contemporary living and dining area with an expansive view of the covered terrace and lush garden. The modern kitchen is equipped with striking Ubatuba green granite countertops, adding a touch of sophistication. Additional ground-floor amenities include a service room, a guest half bathroom, and a secondary bedroom complete with a closet and en-suite bathroom.

Ascend to the upper level to discover a luxurious master bedroom suite, featuring a walk-in closet, private balcony, and well-appointed en-suite bathroom. A second bedroom boasts its own en-suite bathroom, closet, and balcony, providing a comfortable space for family or guests.

The exterior of Malma Homes is designed to enhance your lifestyle with practical amenities. The covered laundry area and a two-car garage with stamped concrete flooring ensure functional living. The covered terrace offers an ideal space for outdoor relaxation and entertainment.

Each Malma Home showcases stylish finishes, such as 60×60 gray floor tiles and sleek black aluminum window frames. The homes come pre-wired for air conditioning and ceiling fans for your convenience. Bathroom countertops are adorned with elegant marble finishes, providing a luxurious touch.

As a resident of Malma Homes, you’ll enjoy exclusive access to a range of fantastic amenities. Maintain an active lifestyle with the jogging track, soccer field, and half basketball court. Unwind with a good book in the outdoor reading area, or watch your little ones have fun at the children’s playground. Host gatherings or simply relax with family and friends at the covered terrace.

Discover your dream home at Malma Homes – where quality living, comfort, and community come together in perfect harmony.

FLOW is a collaboration of two renowned Yucatecan law firms' architecture, internationally awarded: Arkham Projects and Essential Estudio.



With the objective of designing simple but with features necessary to put it in different architecture award competitions.



Investing in flow is investing in a project that will be internationally recognized for its great design.



FLOW LIVING is a development for residential use consisting of 9 apartments with exclusive designs distributed on 3 levels located behind the Marista University, with direct access to the highway Progress that in the same way is a few meters from the UVM and the Anáhuac Mayab, making this the ideal place for students, newly married couples and executives.



The apartments have a Roof Garden, central patio, outdoor seating area, and 11 storage drawers parking lot.

Main garden

#### Property Description

Discover Arthouse Merida, an exclusive residential project where art, architecture, and nature come together to create a unique living experience. Located in the desirable Colonia Alta Brisa in northern Mérida, this development offers a perfect blend of tranquility and connectivity. Just moments away from shopping centers like Plaza Alta Brisa, renowned educational institutions, and top-tier hospitals, Arthouse Merida provides residents with unparalleled convenience and comfort.

Mérida, known for its rich colonial history, traditional architecture, and vibrant cultural scene, is a city of charm and warmth. Frequently ranked as one of the safest cities in Mexico, it’s the ideal destination for those who appreciate art, gastronomy, and entertainment. Arthouse Merida is the manifestation of a vision to create a haven where beauty is not only admired but lived.

The project, meticulously designed by a team of international architects, decorators, and artists, includes a private collection of over 300 art pieces, turning each space into a sanctuary of inspiration. This unique residence also serves as a hub for artists from around the world, fostering a creative community that enriches the everyday life of its inhabitants.

Arthouse Merida offers a range of luxury amenities designed to cater to every need, including:

*   Art gallery
*   Gym
*   Lounge bar
*   Cinema/theater
*   Pool with sunbeds
*   Library
*   Playroom
*   Event salon
*   Pet park
*   Spa

Experience a lifestyle that seamlessly integrates art and living at Arthouse Merida.

Discover Arthouse Merida, an exclusive residential project where art, architecture, and nature come together to create a unique living experience. Located in the desirable Colonia Alta Brisa in northern Mérida, this development offers a perfect blend of tranquility and connectivity. Just moments away from shopping centers like Plaza Alta Brisa, renowned educational institutions, and top-tier hospitals, Arthouse Merida provides residents with unparalleled convenience and comfort.



Mérida, known for its rich colonial history, traditional architecture, and vibrant cultural scene, is a city of charm and warmth. Frequently ranked as one of the safest cities in Mexico, it’s the ideal destination for those who appreciate art, gastronomy, and entertainment. Arthouse Merida is the manifestation of a vision to create a haven where beauty is not only admired but lived.



The project, meticulously designed by a team of international architects, decorators, and artists, includes a private collection of over 300 art pieces, turning each space into a sanctuary of inspiration. This unique residence also serves as a hub for artists from around the world, fostering a creative community that enriches the everyday life of its inhabitants.



Arthouse Merida offers a range of luxury amenities designed to cater to every need, including:




Art gallery



Gym



Lounge bar



Cinema/theater



Pool with sunbeds



Library



Playroom



Event salon



Pet park



Spa




Experience a lifestyle that seamlessly integrates art and living at Arthouse Merida.

Introducing Bocana, an exclusive beachside development in Telchac, Yucatan, where the coast meets your imagination. Located at km 39 Uaymitún road, Telchac Puerto, Bocana offers a seamless blend of architecture and nature, where villas harmonize with their surroundings, respecting the natural elements of the coast such as vegetation, dunes, sea, and sky.



The development consists of 14 apartments and 12 villas, each designed to provide a luxurious living experience that embraces the beauty of the coastal environment.



Amenities:




Gym with ocean views



2 swimming pools with children's area



2 terraces



Business Center



24/7 security and surveillance cameras



Administration booth



Children's play area



Dry marina



Lobby



Zen terrace



Restroom area



Parking




Three-Bedroom Villas:



Choose from four villa options - Cormorán, Kuká, Uva de Mar, and Cocotero - each offering a unique coastal living experience.



Ground Floor:




Living room



Dining room



Kitchen with pantry



Bathroom



Terrace



Private pool



Service room with bathroom



Storage room



3 parking spaces




First Floor:




Bedroom 2 with full bathroom & walk-in closet



Bedroom 3 with full bathroom & walk-in closet



TV room




Second Floor:




Master bedroom with full bathroom & walk-in closet



Balcony lookout




At Bocana, experience the coastal lifestyle like never before. This stunning development is designed to immerse you in the natural beauty of the Yucatan coast, providing the perfect retreat for relaxation, entertainment, and luxury living. Don't miss your chance to be part of this extraordinary beachside community in Telchac, where the coast meets your imagination.

As the community continues to modernize, property values in Temozón Norte are expected to rise, making it a prime area for investment.

TEMOZÓN 53 offers a serene environment while being close to the city’s conveniences, improving your quality of life. Designed to accommodate a variety of lifestyles, TEMOZÓN 53 provides multiple models and living spaces to match your personal needs.

Exclusive amenities include a paddle tennis court, rooftop pool, coworking center, a welcoming lobby, and a rooftop terrace, ensuring that residents can enjoy recreation and relaxation year-round. The development also features a commercial area for added convenience.

TEMOZÓN 53 is the perfect place to enhance your lifestyle and grow within a thriving community.

Introducing Bocana, an exclusive beachside development in Telchac, Yucatan, where the coast meets your imagination. Located at km 39 Uaymitún road, Telchac Puerto, Bocana offers a seamless blend of architecture and nature, where villas harmonize with their surroundings, respecting the natural elements of the coast such as vegetation, dunes, sea, and sky.



The development consists of 14 apartments and 12 villas, each designed to provide a luxurious living experience that embraces the beauty of the coastal environment.



Amenities:




Gym with ocean views



2 swimming pools with children's area



2 terraces



Business Center



24/7 security and surveillance cameras



Administration booth



Children's play area



Dry marina



Lobby



Zen terrace



Restroom area



Parking




Three-Bedroom Villas:



Choose from four villa options - Cormorán, Kuká, Uva de Mar, and Cocotero - each offering a unique coastal living experience.



Ground Floor:




Living room



Dining room



Kitchen with pantry



Bathroom



Terrace



Private pool



Service room with bathroom



Storage room



3 parking spaces




First Floor:




Bedroom 2 with full bathroom & walk-in closet



Bedroom 3 with full bathroom & walk-in closet



TV room




Second Floor:




Master bedroom with full bathroom & walk-in closet



Balcony lookout




At Bocana, experience the coastal lifestyle like never before. This stunning development is designed to immerse you in the natural beauty of the Yucatan coast, providing the perfect retreat for relaxation, entertainment, and luxury living. Don't miss your chance to be part of this extraordinary beachside community in Telchac, where the coast meets your imagination.

#### Property Description

More than a place, Enso is a state of mind and a lifestyle. It is the material expression of a free and creative vision with oriental roots, where the beauty of natural elements, the discreet elegance of simple lines and volumes, and the serene luxury of simplicity are valued.

Enso is calm, but also the impulse in the search for inner balance, the natural path to achieve the full enjoyment of personal well-being. Therefore, it is the destiny of Enso to mark a before and after in housing developments in Mérida, defining the category of architectural craftsmanship.

Mérida, the capital of the state of Yucatán, is the heart of southeastern Mexico and concentrates the complete range of commercial, logistical, educational, recreational, and health services, among others.

The so-called White City is today one of the entities with the highest rates of safety and quality of life in Mexico, comparable even to some Scandinavian cities. 

The northern area of ​​Mérida is today the one with the most significant added value and development in the city. Through its unbeatable connectivity, it is the gateway to the most exclusive services and a wide variety of entertainment options. 

Right here, in an area of ​​more than 15,000 m2, Enso is born, a vertical housing project that will soon redefine its surroundings and is called to be the most iconic green lung in the area.

Since its very conception, Enso has been faithful to immutable design principles, in perfect harmony with a sustainable spirit expressed through the implementation of eco techniques.

In Enso, every day its inhabitants will design their own life experiences. For this, they have at their disposal a range of exclusive services and amenities that promote coexistence or, the enjoyment of ideal spaces for meeting oneself.

More than a place, Enso is a state of mind and a lifestyle. It is the material expression of a free and creative vision with oriental roots, where the beauty of natural elements, the discreet elegance of simple lines and volumes, and the serene luxury of simplicity are valued.



Enso is calm, but also the impulse in the search for inner balance, the natural path to achieve the full enjoyment of personal well-being. Therefore, it is the destiny of Enso to mark a before and after in housing developments in Mérida, defining the category of architectural craftsmanship.



Mérida, the capital of the state of Yucatán, is the heart of southeastern Mexico and concentrates the complete range of commercial, logistical, educational, recreational, and health services, among others.



The so-called White City is today one of the entities with the highest rates of safety and quality of life in Mexico, comparable even to some Scandinavian cities. 



The northern area of ​​Mérida is today the one with the most significant added value and development in the city. Through its unbeatable connectivity, it is the gateway to the most exclusive services and a wide variety of entertainment options. 



Right here, in an area of ​​more than 15,000 m2, Enso is born, a vertical housing project that will soon redefine its surroundings and is called to be the most iconic green lung in the area.



Since its very conception, Enso has been faithful to immutable design principles, in perfect harmony with a sustainable spirit expressed through the implementation of eco techniques.



In Enso, every day its inhabitants will design their own life experiences. For this, they have at their disposal a range of exclusive services and amenities that promote coexistence or, the enjoyment of ideal spaces for meeting oneself.

#### Property Description

Welcome to Campo Magno, an exquisite residential project nestled in the heart of Yucatan, where the vibrant city of Merida beckons with its rich history, thriving economy, and unmatched safety. Merida, ranked as the second safest city in the Americas and one of the safest in the world, has witnessed remarkable growth in the past decade, attracting both national and international attention.

Strategically located near ports and major access roads, Merida enjoys tremendous commercial significance, reflected in its robust infrastructure and flourishing economy. Yet amidst this dynamic atmosphere, the city exudes an undeniable sense of tranquility and security. The streets of Merida boast captivating colonial facades, illuminating the tapestry of Mayan heritage that weaves through its veins.

Here, in Campo Magno, life takes on a new meaning. In a state known for its exceptional safety standards, you can embrace worry-free days and revel in the epitome of a high-quality lifestyle. We offer 86 residential lots starting from 4,337 square feet, allowing you to craft a home that perfectly encapsulates your vision.

Campo Magno has been meticulously designed to embody the essence of Mexican identity, marrying beauty with functionality. Our residential area is thoughtfully created to enhance the well-being of your family, offering a comfortable and private space adorned with personalized services and an array of amenities.

Immerse yourself in a world of convenience and leisure right at your doorstep. Our extensive list of amenities includes a parking area, front desk service, an exclusive cigar club for adults, an events room, and a delightful terrace pool restaurant/snack bar. For our younger residents, a kids club, swimming pool with a dedicated swimming lane, kiddie pool, and children’s playground await their boundless energy.

Sports enthusiasts can enjoy the 2 paddle courts, a 7-a-side soccer field, and a half basketball court in the park, while the multisport simulator caters to those seeking diverse athletic experiences. Indulge in relaxation and rejuvenation at our spa/massage area, steam, and sauna rooms, and take advantage of our business center, gym, lockers, and Junior’s Club.

At Campo Magno, we believe in crafting a lifestyle that transcends expectations, providing a harmonious blend of physical, emotional, and social development opportunities for your family. Come and experience the epitome of Mexican living in a place that encapsulates beauty, luxury, and tranquility. Your dream home awaits in Campo Magno, where a life of fulfillment begins.

Welcome to Campo Magno, an exquisite residential project nestled in the heart of Yucatan, where the vibrant city of Merida beckons with its rich history, thriving economy, and unmatched safety. Merida, ranked as the second safest city in the Americas and one of the safest in the world, has witnessed remarkable growth in the past decade, attracting both national and international attention.



Strategically located near ports and major access roads, Merida enjoys tremendous commercial significance, reflected in its robust infrastructure and flourishing economy. Yet amidst this dynamic atmosphere, the city exudes an undeniable sense of tranquility and security. The streets of Merida boast captivating colonial facades, illuminating the tapestry of Mayan heritage that weaves through its veins.



Here, in Campo Magno, life takes on a new meaning. In a state known for its exceptional safety standards, you can embrace worry-free days and revel in the epitome of a high-quality lifestyle. We offer 86 residential lots starting from 4,337 square feet, allowing you to craft a home that perfectly encapsulates your vision.



Campo Magno has been meticulously designed to embody the essence of Mexican identity, marrying beauty with functionality. Our residential area is thoughtfully created to enhance the well-being of your family, offering a comfortable and private space adorned with personalized services and an array of amenities.



Immerse yourself in a world of convenience and leisure right at your doorstep. Our extensive list of amenities includes a parking area, front desk service, an exclusive cigar club for adults, an events room, and a delightful terrace pool restaurant/snack bar. For our younger residents, a kids club, swimming pool with a dedicated swimming lane, kiddie pool, and children's playground await their boundless energy.



Sports enthusiasts can enjoy the 2 paddle courts, a 7-a-side soccer field, and a half basketball court in the park, while the multisport simulator caters to those seeking diverse athletic experiences. Indulge in relaxation and rejuvenation at our spa/massage area, steam, and sauna rooms, and take advantage of our business center, gym, lockers, and Junior's Club.



At Campo Magno, we believe in crafting a lifestyle that transcends expectations, providing a harmonious blend of physical, emotional, and social development opportunities for your family. Come and experience the epitome of Mexican living in a place that encapsulates beauty, luxury, and tranquility. Your dream home awaits in Campo Magno, where a life of fulfillment begins.

#### Property Description

Introducing Sereniti, an exclusive and private vertical residential development located within Tamara, Merida’s most successful residential community. Sereniti offers 113 units spread across two towers, featuring six distinct apartment layouts catering to various needs and stages of life.

Nestled within the fully-gated Tamara community, Sereniti ensures absolute privacy. The development showcases organic urbanism, spacious living, and a lush landscape design that encourages an active, social, and outdoor lifestyle. Tamara features controlled access, surveillance, wide tree-lined avenues, jogging trails, and six thematic parks.

Why leave home when you can have everything at your doorstep?

Adjacent to the residential complex, Patio Central, a “Neighborhood Center,” is being built, allowing residents to walk or cycle to shops and services that make everyday life more comfortable and enjoyable.

Patio Central will include:

*   Café
*   Dry cleaner
*   Coworking and office spaces
*   Restaurant
*   Bank
*   Pharmacy
*   Supermarket

Experience a premium, integrated lifestyle at Sereniti, where each day presents new opportunities to enjoy sports and recreational activities within a vast, unique space. If you’re looking to make an excellent investment and enjoy a comfortable lifestyle with every convenience imaginable, choosing an apartment in Sereniti is your best decision.

Amenities that elevate your quality of life:

*   Motor lobby
*   Covered terrace
*   Gym
*   Paddle court
*   Coworking space
*   Lounge bar
*   Lobby with concierge service
*   Sundecks
*   Swimming pool
*   Grill and BBQ area
*   Gardens
*   Covered parking
*   Guest parking

Sereniti’s apartments include the following finishes and features:

Kitchen:

*   Fully-fitted kitchen
*   Stainless steel sink with mixer tap
*   Electric stove
*   Extractor hood
*   Granite countertops
*   Walnut-finished cabinets

Bathrooms:

*   Tempered glass enclosures
*   Bathroom furniture with walnut-finished cabinets
*   Marble countertops

Lighting and electrical:

*   Inverter mini-splits in the living room and bedrooms
*   LED lighting
*   Hydro-pneumatic water pressure

Floors and finishes:

*   Marble floors
*   Wood-like porcelain tile flooring on terraces
*   European-style aluminum windows
*   Fitted closets

Discover a new standard of living at Sereniti, where comfort, convenience, and a vibrant lifestyle come together in the heart of Merida’s thriving Tamara community.
